raw.title: Senior DevOps Engineer
raw.description:
SENIOR DEVOPS ENGINEER

Catapult is building the future of sports performance technology, with a mission to Unleash the Potential of every athlete and team on earth. We don't just work in the sporting industry; we are actively changing it.  Since 2006, our solutions have been leading the way in sports performance software, science, and data, in a world where 1% can literally mean the difference between winning and losing.

We work with over 5,000+ teams around the world, empowering coaches, managers and trainers in premier teams in the NFL, NBA, NHL, MLS, EPL, AFL, NRL, NCAA and more. We provide the information they need to optimize athletes' health, game-day readiness, and performance, as well as in-game tactics.  

Catapult is a sports technology company that empowers professional teams to make data-driven decisions. We deliver health, performance, video, and AI insights from the locker room to competitive environments, ensuring every decision is an opportunity to gain an advantage, sharpen performance, and build lasting success. 

WE WANT PEOPLE WHO ARE PASSIONATE ABOUT SOLVING HARD PROBLEMS

We are looking for a Senior DevOps Engineer to help build, operate and improve the infrastructure, platforms and tools that enable our teams to develop, deliver and run reliable software at scale.

Based in Cologne, you will join a team with broad ownership of our technical environment. We take a cloud-agnostic approach, combining cloud services and self-hosted infrastructure to meet the needs of our products and engineering teams. Our responsibilities span the full lifecycle, from provisioning and deployment to observability, security and ongoing operation.

You will combine infrastructure expertise with automation and software engineering to improve how our software is built, deployed and operated. This includes streamlining development workflows, integrating and maintaining shared tools, and supporting demanding workloads across data processing, media and machine learning. Working closely with engineering teams and colleagues across the business, you will build practical solutions that support our expanding product portfolio.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys solving a wide range of technical problems, takes ownership from initial idea through to production, and thrives in a fast-growing environment where priorities and requirements evolve quickly. You will help shape how our infrastructure, platforms and tools adapt as the business grows.

WHAT YOU'LL DO 

  • Design, operate, and continuously improve our Kubernetes platform across both self-hosted clusters and AWS
  • Own our infrastructure as code using Terraform and Ansible, driving a GitOps workflow to ensure all changes are versioned, reviewed, and reproducible
  • Build and maintain robust CI/CD pipelines (GitLab CI) and shared templates that empower product teams to build, test, and deploy reliably
  • Operate and scale specialized infrastructure for demanding workloads, including GPU clusters for computer vision models, media engines, and data analytics platforms 
  • Evolve our observability stack to proactively monitor system health, define meaningful alerting, and ensure high availability
  • Drive platform security and compliance through continuous vulnerability scanning, automated image screening, robust secrets management, and strict access controls
  • Collaborate closely with software engineers, data scientists, and product teams to design scalable architectures and act as a strategic technical partner for new infrastructure initiatives 

Help define technical direction, engineering best practices, and quality standards within the infrastructure domain 

WHAT YOU'LL NEED

  • 5+ years of professional experience in DevOps, Site Reliability Engineering, or Platform Engineering, with a proven track record of designing and scaling highly available production environments 
  • Strong hands-on experience running Kubernetes in production, including upgrades, networking and troubleshooting
  • Solid understanding of cloud infrastructure (AWS) combined with experience operating bare-metal or self-hosted environments

Proven experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, Ansible) and modern container build or GitOps workflowsStrong problem-solving skills and the ability to evaluate technical trade-offs between reliability, scalability, and maintainabilityExperience collaborating across engineering and product teams to deliver secure and robust infrastructure solutionsDeep understanding of Linux operating systems and strong programming or scripting skills (e.g., Python, Go, or Bash) focused on automation and tooling. 

Nice to have – and what would make you exceptional:

  • Experience operating GPU workloads on Kubernetes or Machine Learning infrastructure
  • Familiarity with specialized Kubernetes ecosystem tools such as FluxCD, Rancher, or RKE2.
  • Experience working with large-scale video/streaming workflows or AWS media services
  • Experience managing and scaling messaging or event-streaming systems (e.g., Kafka) 
  • Experience operating and optimizing relational databases (e.g., PostgreSQL) 
  • Experience building internal developer platforms or self-service tooling for engineering teams

WHAT YOUR SUCCESS WILL LOOK LIKE

  • In 6 months time… You know our clusters and pipelines, handle incidents and upgrades on your own, and have shipped your first improvements to reliability, automation or security. You contribute confidently to architecture discussions.
  • In 12 months time… You own major parts of the platform, have delivered measurable improvements (faster deployments, better observability, stronger security), and help shape the roadmap of our hybrid cloud.

WHY CATAPULT? 

  • We have amazing people. We promise you'll work with some of the most ambitious,  intelligent people in an exciting industry, and do some of the best work of your life.
  • We encourage our people to engage in constructive, open, and honest communication to make Catapult extraordinary. 
  • We work in a collaborative yet challenging environment to consistently improve our performance, which in turn impacts our customers' performance.
  • Our workforce spans more than 20 countries. You'll have the opportunity to work with people from multiple nationalities and cultures, and to build your global awareness.  
  • We value improvement and development. We are challenging ourselves to continuously grow and become a high-performance company. That means we maintain a growth mindset in everything we do, and our people are always looking for ways to improve.  There is an unlimited opportunity to grow, do more, and do better.

Whether you're interested in sports or not, you'll have the satisfaction of knowing your work is supporting some of the most successful teams and athletes on the planet! 

Research shows that while men apply for jobs when they meet an average of 60% of the criteria, women and other marginalized groups tend only to apply when they check every box. So if you have what it takes, but don't meet every single point in our job ad, please still get in touch! We would love to have a chat and see if you could be a great addition to our team. We are building the future of sports performance. Our priority is to find the brightest talent who can add to our team culture, actively contribute, and be excited about what they do.

All offers of employment are subject to Catapult's positive prehire check. To find out more, please contact the Talent Partner for this role.

title: Account Executive
description: Caseware ist die globale KI-Plattform für Audit und Accounting. Gegründet vor über 35 Jahren in Toronto, nutzen heute mehr als 500.000 Anwender:innen in 130 Ländern unsere Lösungen, und über 36.000 Fachleute weltweit führen Caseware als Skill auf LinkedIn. Als wachstumsstarkes Technologieunternehmen, backed by Hg, beschleunigen wir die Transformation unserer Branche Richtung Cloud und AI, und bauen die nächste Generation von Audit- und Accounting-Workflows. Wenn du in einem Umfeld arbeiten willst, das global skaliert, technologisch vorne liegt und echten Impact liefert, bist du bei uns richtig. Als Account Executive (m/w/d) bei Caseware wandelst Du Marktinteresse in messbare Ergebnisse. Du gewinnst neue Kunden, baust bestehende Beziehungen gezielt aus und erkennst Potenziale innerhalb deines Kundenportfolios frühzeitig. Mit ausgeprägter Abschlussstärke und einem klaren Gespür für Chancen schaffst du stabile Umsatzströme und nachhaltige Partnerschaften. 📍 Es handelt sich um eine unbefristete Vollzeitposition mit Sitz in Düsseldorf (oder Stuttgart) und einem flexiblen hybriden Arbeitsmodell. Was Du machst: Du treibst den aktiven Vertrieb der Caseware-Lösungen voran, führst beratungsorientierte Gespräche, präsentierst Produkte überzeugend und steuerst den gesamten Sales Cycle souverän. Dabei arbeitest du eng mit Marketing, Consulting und Product Management zusammen. Du baust langfristige Kundenbeziehungen auf und entwickelst sie gezielt weiter, indem du die individuellen Bedürfnisse deiner Ansprechpartner genau verstehst. Du erhöhst den Marktanteil und den ARR in deinem Gebiet, indem du neue Kunden gewinnst, Abschlüsse verlässlich zum Erfolg führst und bestehende Accounts durch Up- und Cross-Selling ausbaust. Du entwickelst strategische Vertriebs- und Account-Pläne und setzt sie konsequent um. Dabei nutzt du bereichsübergreifende Ressourcen gezielt, um Umsatzpotenziale zu erschließen und Verkaufschancen erfolgreich zum Abschluss zu bringen. Du steuerst deine Pipeline strukturiert und diszipliniert und lieferst präzise Forecasts, die klare Entscheidungen ermöglichen und eine verlässliche Entwicklung in Richtung der Vertriebsziele unterstützen. Du stärkst die Marktpräsenz von Caseware und baust dein professionelles Netzwerk aktiv aus, indem du mit wichtigen Entscheidern und relevanten Branchenkontakten im Austausch bist. Du stellst sicher, dass alle Vertriebsaktivitäten, Kundendaten und Vertragsdetails vollständig und korrekt im CRM dokumentiert sind, damit Transparenz und effiziente Abläufe jederzeit gewährleistet sind. Was Du mitbringst: Du kommunizierst überzeugend, trittst souverän auf und schaffst es, schnell tragfähige Beziehungen zu relevanten Stakeholdern aufzubauen. Du hast nachweislich Erfolge in der Gewinnung von Neukunden und im strategischen Ausbau bestehender Kundenbeziehungen erzielt. Du bringst mehrjährige Erfahrung im SaaS- oder Tech-Vertrieb mit und hast Vertriebsziele eigenverantwortlich gesteuert und erreicht. Du arbeitest strukturiert, verlässlich und mit einem hohen Maß an Eigenverantwortung und schaffst damit die Grundlage für nachhaltige Kundenpartnerschaften. Du gehst mit Neugier, Motivation und einer pragmatischen, lösungsorientierten Haltung auf Kunden und ihre Herausforderungen zu. Du hast ein ausgeprägtes Gespür für vertriebliche Potenziale und verstehst, wie sich Kundenbedürfnisse in konkreten Mehrwert übersetzen lassen. Kenntnisse in den Bereichen Audit, Finance oder Accounting sind von Vorteil, aber keine Voraussetzung. Du verfügst über sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift. Was wir Dir bieten: • Flexible Arbeitsgestaltung im Hybrid-Setup: Klare Mischung aus Präsenz- und Remote-Arbeit, gemeinsam definierte Kernzeiten und ein hohes Maß an Eigenverantwortung im Arbeitsalltag.   • Attraktives Gesamtpaket: Wettbewerbsfähiges Fixgehalt mit variablen Bestandteilen, ergänzt durch globale und lokale Benefits sowie betriebliche Altersvorsorge.   • Internationales Arbeitsumfeld: Zusammenarbeit mit Kolleg:innen aus verschiedenen Ländern und Kulturen, Englisch als Arbeitssprache und verlässliche, strukturierte Abstimmung über Teams hinweg. • Sinnstiftendes Produkt mit Kund:innen-Impact: Caseware unterstützt Organisationen dabei, Audit- und Financial-Reporting-Prozesse effizienter und verlässlicher zu gestalten, mit Cloud- und KI-gestützten Lösungen.   • Verantwortung und Entwicklung im Job: Du übernimmst Ownership für relevante Themen, bringst Ideen aktiv ein und entwickelst dich innerhalb der Rolle sowie perspektivisch im Unternehmen weiter, fachlich oder in Richtung Führung.   • Healthcare & Wellbeing: Umfassende Gesundheits- und Wellbeing-Leistungen für dich und deine Familie, orientiert an lokalen Standards. Über Caseware: Caseware entwickelt Software für Wirtschaftsprüfungen, Unternehmen und öffentliche Einrichtungen. Unsere Teams arbeiten eng zusammen, verbessern bestehende Lösungen und entwickeln neue Produkte, die auf die Anforderungen der Zukunft ausgerichtet sind. Mit der Investition von Hg Capital im Jahr 2020 haben wir eine wichtige Wachstumsphase begonnen, in der wir konsequent in Menschen, Produkte und Strukturen investieren. Vielfalt und Zusammenhalt sind uns wichtig. Wir möchten Teams aufbauen, die unterschiedliche Hintergründe und Perspektiven einbringen. title: Account Executive (m/w/d)
description: Your Role   Als Account Executive übernimmst du eine Schlüsselrolle in der Skalierung von JobAuto, indem du potenzielle Partnerunternehmen für unser Mitarbeiter-Benefit Programm JobAuto gewinnst. Dabei bist du für den gesamten Sales Cycle, von Leadgenerierung bis zu Account Closing verantwortlich.  Mit JobAuto richten wir uns an Unternehmen aller Größenordnungen, die ihren Mitarbeitern den Umstieg auf (Elektro-)Mobilität durch Gehaltsumwandlung erleichtern wollen. Mit deiner Leidenschaft für Vertrieb, einem ausgeprägten Geschäftssinn und Blick für die Herausforderungen deiner Kund:innen entwickelst du gemeinsam mit einer Vielzahl interner und externer Stakeholder wertstiftende Lösungen und bringst die Verhandlungen zu erfolgreichem Abschluss. Damit hast du maßgeblichen Einfluss auf den Erfolg und das Wachstum unserer JobAuto Unit. Your Mission Land & Expand: Dein Ziel ist es, unser Produkt bei neuen Geschäftskund:innen zu platzieren und damit die optimale Basis für den langfristigen Ausbau von Key Accounts zu legen.  Dafür etablierst du tiefgreifende Beziehungen mit wichtigen Entscheidungsträgern auf VP- und C-Level Ebene. Steuere den gesamten Sales-Cycle: Du bist von der aktiven Leadgenerierung über die Qualifizierung bis zum Closing komplett für die Gewinnung von JobAuto-Kund:innen verantwortlich. Dabei hast du die Möglichkeit, neue Verkaufsstrategien für die Gewinnung von Outbound Leads einzubringen.  Kenne den Markt und unser Produkt: Du entwickelst ein tiefes Verständnis für unser Angebot im Bereich Mobilitätsmanagement und wirst zum Experten für den Markt der Gehaltsumwandlung für Autoabos und unser Angebot.  Entwickle das JobAuto Produkt weiter: Du bist in stetigem Austausch mit unseren Kund:innen, sammelst Feedback und identifizierst Verbesserungspotenziale, um unser Produkt und die JobAuto Customer Journey kontinuierlich weiterzuentwickeln. So stellst du sicher, dass wir Marktchancen optimal nutzen, Prozesse verbessern und unsere Kundenzufriedenheit kontinuierlich steigern. Your Profile Must-have: Ausbildung & Erfahrung: Erfolgreich abgeschlossenes Studium (z. B. BWL, Wirtschaftswissenschaften) oder eine vergleichbare kaufmännische Qualifikation mit nachgewiesener Erfolgsbilanz im B2B-Vertrieb komplexer Unternehmenslösungen . Kommunikations- & Verhandlungsstärke: Exzellente Argumentations- und Networking-Fähigkeiten auf Führungsebene gepaart mit lösungsorientiertem, unternehmerischem Denken . Drive & Eigeninitiative: Starker Bias for Action , Hands-on-Mentalität sowie die Bereitschaft, eine schnell wachsende Sales Unit aktiv mitzugestalten . Sprachkenntnisse: Fließende/Exzellente Deutschkenntnisse (C2-Niveau) sowie verhandlungssichere Englischkenntnisse . Nice-to-have: CRM & Tool-Expertise: Praktische Erfahrung im Umgang mit modernen CRM-Systemen (z. B. HubSpot oder Salesforce) . Mobility & Benefit Experience: Branchenkenntnisse im Bereich E-Mobilität, Auto-Abo, Flottenmanagement oder bei Mitarbeiter-Benefit-Systemen (Gehaltsumwandlung) . WHY FINN Shared Success (VSOP Finanzbeteiligung): Wir gewinnen gemeinsam. Über unser Virtual Stock Option Program  profitierst du direkt vom langfristigen Wertwachstum und dem Erfolg von FINN. Fuel your Growth (1.500€ Weiterbildungsbudget): Stillstand ist keine Option. Mit deinem jährlichen Development-Budget in Höhe von 1.500€ für Fortbildungen und Seminare entscheidest du selbst, wie du dich persönlich und professionell weiterentwickelst. Family First (Kita-Zuschuss & Flexibilität): Wir unterstützen dich und deine Familie. Profitiere von einem monatlichen Zuschuss zur Kinderbetreuung , exklusiven Zugängen zu Kita-Plätzen in München sowie maximaler Flexibilität, um Berufs- und Familienleben stressfrei zu vereinbaren. title: Care Expert – Medizincontrolling & Pflegedokumentation Krankenhaus (m/w/d)
description: 🎤 WARUM voize? WEIL ES UM MEHR GEHT ALS EINEN JOB. Bei voize glauben wir: Das Wertvollste, was wir Menschen in der Pflege geben können, ist Zeit. Zeit für Zuwendung, für Gespräche, fürs Dasein. Heute geht genau diese Zeit in Verwaltungsarbeit und komplexen Systemen verloren. Das wollen wir ändern: mit KI-Begleitern, die digitale Abläufe im Hintergrund übernehmen. Wir ersetzen keine Menschen durch Technik, wir verstärken ihre Wirkung. Hinter unserer Mission steht eine Series-A-Finanzierung über 50 Mio. US-Dollar unter Führung von Balderton Capital, gemeinsam mit HV Capital, Y Combinator und weiteren führenden VCs. Über 2.000 Einrichtungen vertrauen heute auf voize, mehr als 200.000 Nutzer:innen entlastet unser KI-Begleiter im Alltag. Wir verbinden erstklassige Technologie mit echtem gesellschaftlichem Nutzen. Und jetzt suchen wir dich. 💡 DEINE MISSION Im Krankenhaus dokumentieren Pflegekräfte mit voize direkt am Bett. Die freigegebenen Einträge landen strukturiert im KIS, über unsere Integration mit ORBIS U von Dedalus. Damit ist Pflegedokumentation nicht nur Grundlage guter Pflege, sondern auch Grundlage für Kodierung, Abrechnung und MD-Prüfungen. Abgerechnet werden kann nur, was belegt ist. Genau hier brauchen wir deinen Blick aus dem Medizincontrolling. Als Care Expert berätst du Kliniken, wie ihre Pflegedokumentation aufgebaut sein muss, damit erbrachte Leistungen vollständig und prüfsicher in der Akte stehen. Mit den strengeren MD-Prüfquoten ab 2027 wird das für viele Häuser zur wirtschaftlichen Frage. Du arbeitest auf Augenhöhe mit Medizincontrolling, Pflegedirektion, Stationsleitungen und Klinik-IT. Dein Erfolg zeigt sich darin, dass Pflegekräfte Zeit gewinnen und die Dokumentation zugleich den Anforderungen von Kodierung und Prüfung standhält. 🚀 DEIN ALLTAG Dokumentation verstehen, bevor es zählt: Vor dem Go-live analysierst du mit Medizincontrolling, Pflege und Klinik-IT, wie die Pflegedokumentation im KIS aufgebaut ist, von Assessments wie ePA-AC und Barthel über LEP-Maßnahmen bis zu Vitalwerten, Bilanzierung und Wunddokumentation. Die Erlös- und Prüfperspektive einbringen: Du zeigst, welche pflegerischen Inhalte für die Rechtfertigung der Verweildauer, Nebendiagnosen, Komplexbehandlungen wie die geriatrische frührehabilitative Komplexbehandlung und die MD-Prüfung relevant sind, und wo heute Informationen auf dem Weg in die Akte verloren gehen. Zwischen Pflege, Medizincontrolling und System übersetzen: Anforderungen aus Kodierrichtlinien und Prüfverfahren machst du für Pflegeteams greifbar, und Pflegealltag für das Medizincontrolling. Wirkung sichtbar machen: Gemeinsam mit den Kliniken legst du fest, woran sich Dokumentationsqualität messen lässt, und unterstützt bei ROI-Workshops mit Geschäftsführung und Medizincontrolling. Sauber einordnen: Läuft etwas nicht wie erwartet, findest du heraus, ob es an der KIS-Konfiguration, am Prozess auf Station oder am Produkt liegt. Deine Einschätzung geht klar an Customer Success, Support und Product, und du bringst die Sicht des Medizincontrollings in die Weiterentwicklung unseres Krankenhaus-Produkts ein. Kliniken begleiten: Remote und bei Bedarf vor Ort begleitest du Einführungen über den Go-live hinaus, eng abgestimmt mit dem zuständigen Customer Success Manager. Wissen aufbauen, das skaliert: Gemeinsam mit dem Team entwickelst du Playbooks, Checklisten und interne Enablements für den Krankenhausbereich, etwa zu DRG-Grundlagen und MD-Prüfungen für unsere Kolleg:innen. 🤝 DEIN PROFIL Du hast mindestens eine Weiterbildung zur Medizinischen Kodierfachkraft oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation und Praxis im Medizincontrolling eines Krankenhauses. Erfahrung als Medizincontroller:in ist ein großes Plus. Du bist sicher im aG-DRG-System, in ICD-10-GM, OPS und den Deutschen Kodierrichtlinien und kennst die Abläufe rund um MD-Prüfungen und die Prüfverfahrensvereinbarung aus eigener Fallbearbeitung. Idealerweise bringst du einen pflegerischen Grundberuf mit, etwa in der Gesundheits- und Krankenpflege, und weißt, wie Dokumentation auf Station wirklich entsteht. Du hast mit einem KIS gearbeitet, am liebsten mit ORBIS von Dedalus. Pflegerische Assessments und Leistungserfassung wie ePA-AC oder LEP sind dir vertraut oder du arbeitest dich schnell ein. Systeme sind für dich Werkzeug, kein Hindernis. Du denkst in Abhängigkeiten und Ursachen und bleibst dran, bis du verstehst, warum etwas so ist. Du erklärst Komplexes einfach, einer Pflegedirektion genauso wie einer Pflegekraft im Spätdienst oder der Geschäftsführung einer Klinik. Du arbeitest gern beratend und strukturiert. Du gibst klare Empfehlungen und vertrittst sie auch. Du sprichst fließend Deutsch. Auf Englisch solltest du dich sicher verständigen können, weil ein Teil der internen Zusammenarbeit auf Englisch läuft. Du bist gern bei unseren Kunden. Termine vor Ort gehören regelmäßig dazu, der Großteil deiner Arbeit läuft remote. 🌱 GEMEINSAM WACHSEN – DAS ERWARTET DICH BEI voize Wir sind ein schnell wachsendes Startup. Du übernimmst neue Themen, wächst schnell und bewirkst etwas, das Pflegekräften mehr Zeit für die Menschen gibt. Du gestaltest mit: Unser Krankenhausbereich wächst gerade, und du prägst, wie wir Kliniken fachlich begleiten. Wir leben eine offene, kollaborative Kultur mit regelmäßigen Team-Events, ob du aus unserem Berliner Office arbeitest oder remote aus Deutschland. Mit Stock Options wirst du Teil unseres Erfolgs. 30 Urlaubstage plus dein Geburtstag frei, Deutschlandticket, Urban Sports Club, regelmäßige Company-Offsites sowie Zugang zu Lernplattformen wie Blinkist und Audible. Du entscheidest, wann du am besten arbeitest: flexible Arbeitszeiten und ein gutes Hybrid-Setup. ✨ LUST AUF EIN GESPRÄCH? JETZT BEWERBEN. Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung und darauf, dich kennenzulernen, ganz gleich, wer du bist und welchen Hintergrund du mitbringst. Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

The discipline of using those inputs — requesting briefs before first calls, completing HubSpot fields that trigger Isabel's onboarding, registering every lead in Introw on the day — is what makes the whole system work.

Your Role

Pipeline and revenue ownership — your region

  • Own the partner pipeline and revenue target for your region — you are the person who drives the strategy to meet and exceed this number, not just a contributor to it

  • Build and maintain a consistent bottoms-up pipeline plan, built up against your region's targets and TAM — showing exactly how your book of business adds up to your target, by partner type and by deal stage

  • Forecast monthly, ahead of the full-team KPR review — reforecasting pipeline and revenue coverage against target, reconciling to the latest refreshed regional targets/TAM where these have moved, so gaps are visible early and plans can be adjusted before target dates, not after

Regional partner development — all partner types

  • Build and manage the full partner portfolio in your territory: integration partners, resellers, consultants, hotel management companies, and referral partners

  • Source new reseller and consultant contacts in your region — using the Ideal Reseller Partner Profile as the qualification standard

  • Execute the partner conversation playbook for each contact type: open with the partner intelligence brief, use the CS manager and KAM conversation guides for integration partners, apply the reseller screening framework for agency contacts

  • Request a partner intelligence brief from the Director Channel Growth - Integration before every first partner outreach — no first conversation without a brief

  • Complete the 4 mandatory HubSpot fields (deal stage, partner fields, agreement file, partnership type) before advancing any deal past the signed stage — this triggers Isabel's onboarding program

  • Register every qualified lead in Introw on the day it is received, tagged by source type (integration referral / reseller / consultant / reactivated dormant)

Global Partner Account Management

  • Own one or two assigned global partner accounts — relationships where the partner operates across multiple BDM territories and requires consistent commercial management above the regional level

  • Build the regional strategy for each assigned global account that generates pipeline — not just relationship maintenance; you are responsible for identifying where the pipeline comes from in your territory and driving it

  • Coordinate with Global Partner Marketing Manager before any senior touchpoint at a global partner account — global commercial context will be provided; you provide the regional relationship intelligence

  • Feed the Head of Global Partnerships and the Global Partner Marketing Manager with global account intelligence after every significant touchpoint — health signals, competitive intelligence, co-marketing opportunities, and any escalation requirements

  • Support the coordination of co-marketing and QBR activity with the global partner where it involves your region

Long Tail Activation — Regional subset

  • Own your regional subset of the 272 dormant signed partners — the Director Channel Growth - Reseller & Consultant,provides the segmented list, you own the outreach

  • Execute the tiered re-engagement approach: Tier 1 (60–90 days dormant) with a personalized message within the first week of assignment; Tier 2 with re-qualification before any effort; Tier 3 with a single attempt then escalation to Isabel to archive

  • Report progress on your regional dormant subset to Isabel weekly during the H2 activation sprint

Market intelligence and HubSpot discipline

  • Surface partner contacts and market intelligence to the Reseller PM in the bi-weekly regional intel exchange — which reseller types are gaining traction, which are declining, what competitive signals are emerging

  • Flag any integration partner conversation where an all-in-one competitive angle appears — the Strategy Manager updates the competitive library with field intelligence

  • Maintain HubSpot contact and deal records at the expected quality standard — the data in HubSpot is what the whole team uses to run the business; poor data quality breaks Isabel's onboarding, Isabel's dormancy tracking, and Introw attribution simultaneously

  • Participate in the monthly full-team KPR review — presenting your regional lead pipeline and flagging any structural blockers

Your Profile

  • 2+ years in a B2B business development, partnerships, or commercial account management role — ideally in SaaS, hospitality technology, or a related field

  • Demonstrates advanced proficiency in German (C2 level), with excellent command of both

  • Track record of building relationships and generating pipeline from scratch in a defined territory — not managing inbound, but generating outbound

  • Comfortable operating across multiple partner types and conversation styles in a single week — integration partnership conversations require a different approach than reseller qualification

  • HubSpot or CRM discipline — this is a non-negotiable requirement; the quality of your data determines the quality of the team's output

  • Based in the target territory — regional credibility and proximity to local partners is part of the role

Nice to Have

  • Existing network in the hotel technology ecosystem (PMS, channel manager, consultants, or revenue management) in the relevant territory

  • Experience managing global or multi-territory accounts in addition to a local territory portfolio

  • Familiarity with Introw, PartnerStack, Reditus, or similar partner and commission tracking platforms

  • Revenue management or hospitality operations background — understanding how an independent hotel owner thinks is a genuine advantage in partner conversations

At RoomPriceGenie, we don’t just offer jobs; we offer an adventure! 🚀 Join us in an exciting startup atmosphere where you can grow your career while changing the world for tens of thousands of independent hoteliers. 🌍 Our global and diverse team is fueled by passion and a shared mission. title: Senior Legal Counsel, Product
description: The AI orchestration of your wildest imagination. n8n is the open workflow orchestration platform built for the new era of AI. We give technical teams the freedom of code with the speed of no-code, so they can automate faster, smarter, and without limits. Backed by a fiercely inventive community and 500+ builder-approved integrations, we’re changing the way people bring systems together and scale ideas for impact. Since our founding in 2019, we’ve grown into a diverse team of over 260 - working across Europe and the US, connected by a shared builder spirit and with our centre of gravity in Berlin. Along the way, we’ve: Cultivated a community of more than 650,000 active developers and builders Earned 190K+ GitHub stars, making us one of the world’s Top 40 most popular projects Backed by top investors, from Sequoia’s first German seed to our SAP's recent strategic investment - bringing us to a $5.2bn valuation That’s the company we’ve built. Now we’d love to see what you can build. If you’re applying, try n8n out - whether you’re technical or not - and share a screenshot of your first workflow with us. The easiest place to start is here: app.n8n.cloud/register . We’re in a defining moment of an incredible journey. Come and build with us. Job Description 🎯 You will be a trusted legal partner to our Product and R&D leadership and teams, as our privacy and product counsel. As such you will specifically be supporting our Product and R&D teams, developing further our readiness for AI regulation and advising on wider digital regulatory requirements, to allow n8n to keep building and be early. You will also help shape a modern, AI-first legal strategy as part of a growing Legal team, and bring your product insight to the technology and commercial deals where it makes the difference. You will report to the General Counsel. What success looks like after 6 months: you are the go-to legal partner in Product and R&D roadmap, you design and launch reviews, our AI regulation readiness plan is in place with clear owners, and templates and playbooks are updated so the wider Legal team can run standard deals without R&D and Product related escalation. Responsibilities: Partner with Product and R&D (c. 80% of the role) Partner with the existing Legal team to build out our current approach to AI regulation: EU AI Act readiness and risk classification, AI risk assessments, model and provider due diligence, AI use policies, and customer-facing AI transparency commitments. Partner with others in the Legal team on our response to the wider digital regulatory landscape for software (for example the EU Data Act, and other digital regulation), from horizon scanning through to product readiness and compliance roadmaps. Be the embedded Product and Engineering partner, joining roadmap, design and launch reviews, advising on platform and product terms from the design stage, and turning legal requirements into clear product requirements engineers can build against. Advise on open-source, fair-code and open-core licensing, and on IP questions around AI-generated outputs, machine learning models and training data. Partner with others in the Legal team on privacy questions that arise in product design. Support Product and Engineering with customer, community and regulator questions about how our products meet legal requirements. Support complex technology and commercial deals (c. 20% of the role) Review, draft and negotiate technology-heavy agreements (SaaS and self-hosted), partnership and integration, and AI model and cloud provider contracts. Partner with sales, partnerships and revenue teams on complex enterprise deals with AI or product requirements. Deliver creative, risk-based solutions that protect the business, and feed deal learnings back into product decisions. Scale legal as a business enabler Solve legal questions in real time with a builder mindset. Improve and maintain scalable legal templates, playbooks and training materials together with the Legal team, so that standard deals and product questions do not need legal involvement, so the wider Legal team can run standard deals without escalation. Collaborate with our Automation and Legal Operations to improve our self-serve legal processes and tooling. REQUIREMENTS Must-haves ⚖️ Qualified lawyer (Europe-based): You are a qualified legal professional with 5+ years' post-qualification experience (PQE), with at least 3 of those years within an in-house SaaS or technology environment with a start up or scale up company. 💬 Fluent English: You can clearly communicate legal nuance in plain terms to global stakeholders. 🤖 Product, AI and digital regulation expert: You have substantial, hands-on experience of acting as a trusted business partner to and advising technology teams on regulatory matters such as the EU AI Act and related digital regulation and a clear track record of getting up to speed on new regulation quickly. 🔓 Open-source and licensing: You have working knowledge of open-source, fair-code or open-core licensing and how it applies to software products. 🌍 Cross-functional collaborator: You have experience supporting engineers, product managers and sales teams, and can demonstrate how you balance legal risk with product and revenue goals. 🛠️ Builder mindset: You are comfortable with ambiguity, enjoy solving problems with and without a playbook, and look for ways to improve how legal works. 🏃 Fast-scaling environment experience: You have worked where priorities shift quickly and your impact is immediate. 📄 Commercial and technology contracts: You have solid working experience with SaaS and self-hosted software license agreements. Nice-to-haves 🧠 Curiosity for tech and automation: You are excited to experiment with legal tech, AI tools and scalable internal systems. 🎓 AI or technology law credentials: for example AIGP, or equivalent practical experience. 💬 Other Languages: You can communicate in German with customers and stakeholders. Why join us? At n8n, your work won't disappear into a shared drive. It will shape how a category-defining company builds products and does deals. You will be embedded with Product and R&D, with commercial work where your product expertise matters most. You will join a senior Legal team, helping embed AI-first thinking into everything we do, in a fast-growing, remote-first team that values ownership, pragmatism and speed. Sound like a challenge you are excited to take on? Apply now, and help us build the future of automation. If you meet most but not all of the requirements, we still encourage you to apply. n8n is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We can sponsor visas to Germany; for any other country, you need to have existing right to work. Our company language is English. You care about diversity and inclusion? We do too! Check out our Diversity, Inclusion and Belonging initiatives at n8n ( https://www.notion.so/n8n/Diversity-inclusion-and-belonging-n8n-c1bec2fff536422d868b1a438d990e35 ). Location disclaimer: If you see multiple job postings for the same role, it is most likely because we're hiring remotely for this role and posting in different locations to make sure every potential candidate can see the role. Please apply to the location you're the most likely to work from in the future. Benefits Competitive compensation 💸 – We offer fair and attractive pay. Ownership 💪 – Our core value is to “empower others,” and we mean it—you’ll get a slice of n8n with equity. Work/life balance 🏖️ – We work hard but ensure you have time to recharge: Europe: 30 days of vacation, plus public holidays wherever you are. US: 20 vacation days, 8 sick days, plus public holidays wherever you are. Health & wellness 🩺 – Europe: We provide benefits according to local country norms.* US : Multiple low-premium, low-deductible medical plans with coverage for individuals and families—plus a no-cost premium HDHP option with a pre-seeded HSA—along with dental and vision coverage. Future planning 💰 – Europe: We provide pension contributions according to local country norms.* US: 401(k) retirement plan with a 4% employer match. Financial security 🛡️ – Europe: We provide benefits according to local country norms.* US: Company-paid short-term and long-term disability insurance, plus life insurance to support you and your loved ones. Career growth 📈 – We hire rising stars who grow with us! You’ll get €1K (or equivalent) per year to spend on courses, books, events, or coaching to level up your skills. A passionate team 🤩 – We love our product, and we prove it with regular hackathons where we see who can build the coolest thing with it! Remote-first 🌏 – Our team works remotely across Europe, with regular off-sites for team bonding. Some roles, like sales in the US, are hybrid—please check the job description. Giving back 🤝 – We're big fans of open source, and you'll get $100 per month to support projects you care about. Transparency 🙏 – We all know what everyone’s working on, how the company is doing—the whole shebang. *Country and/or State specific details provided in your employment agreement.   • You've found at least one organic and one paid channel that bring in signups week after week.

  • You post on LinkedIn and X every week, and your audience in creator marketing is growing.

  • Experiments ship every week, and each one ends with a written result.

  • €40,000–80,000 per year, depending on experience. Virtual stock options (VSOP) are possible for the right person.

Apply with your CV and answer four short questions. Add links to real work in your application: pages you ranked, campaigns, dashboards or writing. They tell us more than a cover letter.

Based in our Berlin Headquarters, you'll help build best-in-class analytics to support price and discount strategy across HelloFresh's brands — turning data into strategic recommendations, challenging the status quo, and directly shaping how our global brands price, grow, and operate.</p> <p>Reporting to the Associate Director of Pricing Analytics, you'll partner closely with the commercial Pricing &amp; Discount Strategy team and stakeholders across Product, Engineering, ML&amp;AI, and Finance. As our scope expands, there's room to grow into broader <strong>Market Insights</strong> work supporting senior leadership across our 15+ markets.</p> <h2>What You'll Do</h2> <ul> <li><strong>Own price and discount experiments end to end</strong> — frame the hypothesis, design the test, size it, launch it through our always-on testing program, and deliver the readout.</li> <li><strong>Model how customers respond to price and promotions</strong> — price elasticity, geo-segmented pricing, discount and promo effects, and ML-assisted discount recommendations.</li> <li><strong>Apply causal inference</strong> — incrementality and quasi-experimental methods (difference-in-differences, synthetic control, matching) — to measure true impact where a clean A/B test isn't possible.</li> <li><strong>Ship analysis as data products</strong> — production pipelines and self-serve apps (Databricks, SQL, Python, Streamlit) that stakeholders use directly, not one-off notebooks.</li> <li><strong>Build and enhance reporting and visualization assets</strong> that support day-to-day pricing decisions and strengthen performance oversight.</li> <li><strong>Communicate complex technical findings</strong> as clear recommendations and tangible next steps for commercial leaders without a technical background.</li> <li><strong>Collaborate with data science, finance, and marketing</strong> to measure discount impact consistently across gross and net revenue and short- and long-term customer profitability.</li> <li><strong>Collaborate with and mentor analysts</strong> within the team, championing scalable, automated, and reproducible ways of working.</li> <li><strong>As scope grows</strong>, measure, benchmark, and monitor brand and market performance and help inform Marketing budgets — contributing to the Market Insights agenda alongside senior stakeholders.</li> </ul> <h2>What You'll Bring</h2> <ul> <li>A <strong>motivated, collaborative mindset</strong> with strong team-working skills and a passion for solving complex business problems.</li> <li><strong>4+ years of experience</strong> in data science, analytics, or a related quantitative field — ideally in a fast-paced B2C or subscription business.</li> <li><strong>Strong SQL and Python</strong> (required) — you're comfortable owning an analysis end to end.</li> <li>A foundation in <strong>experimental design and A/B testing</strong>, including how to size a test and choose primary and guardrail metrics.</li> <li>Working knowledge of <strong>causal inference and econometrics</strong> — price elasticity, incrementality, and quasi-experimental methods.</li> <li>Solid <strong>applied statistics</strong>, and familiarity with common <strong>machine-learning</strong> methods (regression, trees, clustering; uplift / heterogeneous-effects a plus) — with the judgment to know when a method genuinely helps and when a simpler approach is better.</li> <li>A strong understanding of <strong>Marketing and Growth metrics</strong> and how they connect to overall business performance.</li> <li>Comfort in a <strong>modern data stack</strong> (Databricks / Spark / a SQL warehouse) and a visualization tool (<strong>Tableau</strong>, Looker, or Power BI; or apps built in Streamlit).</li> <li>A <strong>results-oriented, structured approach</strong>, able to turn vague or ambiguous business questions into clear analytical frameworks and insights.</li> <li>Proven <strong>project ownership and stakeholder management</strong>, especially in senior or cross-functional settings.</li> <li><strong>Excellent communication skills in English</strong>, with the ability to explain analytical concepts to non-technical audiences and influence decision-making.</li> </ul> <p>Nice to have:</p> <ul> <li>Pricing, discounting, or marketing-analytics domain experience.</li> <li>Market Insights / market-benchmarking experience supporting senior leadership.</li> <li>Bayesian or hierarchical / mixed-effects modeling.</li> <li>GenAI / LLM tooling for analytics (e.g., natural-language-to-SQL, Most of our traffic runs on self-hosted, fine-tuned open-weight models. On our internal roleplay evals, our smaller fine-tuned models can outperform much larger off-the-shelf models. Your job is to make them better.

You’ll join a small AI team led by Marco, our LLM Tech Lead, working closely with our CTO, Product, Web and DevOps teams. You’ll work across data, post-training, evals, and model behavior, taking ideas from failure analysis to production.

If you want to shape model behavior at consumer scale, this is the role.

  • Fine-tune open-weight LLMs using SFT, LoRA/QLoRA and post-training methods such as DPO and GRPO

  • Diagnose model failures and turn them into experiments. Decide whether the answer is better data, post-training, prompting or classifiers

  • Build training data and evals that directly shape what gets trained next

  • Improve model behavior across personalization, consistency, tone, multilingual and group interactions

  • Ship to production and use real user behavior to guide the next iteration

  • Speed up the training loop so experiments are faster, easier to compare, and more reproducible

  • You’ve worked where AI was core to the product or business, not an experimental side feature

  • You can take work beyond notebooks into production

  • You use AI tools daily in your own engineering work

  • You are fully comfortable working with uncensored models and explicit NSFW content, including harmful material when developing and evaluating moderation system

  • Experience with conversational AI, roleplay products, or highly personalized consumer AI

⚡ AI Tools Access: Premium access to ChatGPT, Hugging Face, Claude Code, and any other tool needed to excel at your job, power your ideas and workflows

title: Security Engineer
description: ÜBER UNSERE COMPANY freiheit.com wurde 1999 in Hamburg gegründet und entwickelt seitdem custom large-scale Softwareprodukte. Unsere Mission ist: “Ship great software”. In mehr als zwei Jahrzehnten haben wir immer das ausgeliefert, was wir versprochen haben – “always on time, on budget, on target and on quality”. 85% unserer Members sind Software Engineers mit Abschlüssen in Informatik, Physik oder Mathematik, viele auch mit fundierten Kenntnissen in Maschinellem Lernen und Künstlicher Intelligenz.  Seit über einem Vierteljahrhundert arbeiten wir für das „Who’s Who“ der deutschen und europäischen Industrie- und Handelsunternehmen. Retail, Automotive, E-Commerce, Healthcare und mehr. Unsere large-scale Softwareprodukte werden täglich von Millionen von Benutzern verwendet und sind entscheidend für den wirtschaftlichen Erfolg unserer Kunden. Jedes Produkt ist somit geschäftskritisch und ist von strategischer Relevanz.  Gemeinsam machen wir “mission impossible possible”.  Unser Team besteht aus 300+ Members aus der ganzen Welt. In unseren Büros in Hamburg und Lissabon bauen wir gemeinsam Produkte, die noch nie jemand zuvor entwickelt hat. Unsere Teams arbeiten datengetrieben, um ihre eigene Produktivität ständig zu optimieren. Jedes Teammitglied übernimmt die “end-to-end” Verantwortung für seine Arbeit. Um erfolgreich zu sein, muss man produktiv sein. Um produktiv zu sein, muss man effizient und effektiv sein. Technology never rests. Neither do we. ÜBER DEINEN JOB Wir sind der festen Überzeugung, dass Sicherheit ein technisches Thema ist. Deshalb glauben wir, dass nur ein echter Engineer für die Sicherheit bei freiheit.com verantwortlich sein kann. Nur wenn Du weißt, wie die Dinge funktionieren, kannst Du Prozesse und Richtlinien entwerfen, um uns und unsere Daten sicher und geschützt zu halten. Du entwirfst und implementierst die Infrastruktur, damit Du einfache, aber dennoch zuverlässige und sichere Prozesse sowie Richtlinien einführen kannst. 85% unserer Members sind Software Engineers mit Abschlüssen in Informatik, Physik oder Mathematik, viele auch mit fundierten Kenntnissen in Maschinellem Lernen und Künstlicher Intelligenz.

Retail, Automotive, E-Commerce, Healthcare und mehr.

Gemeinsam machen wir “mission impossible possible”. 

Unser Team besteht aus 300+ Members aus der ganzen Welt. In unseren Büros in Hamburg und Lissabon bauen wir gemeinsam Produkte, die noch nie jemand zuvor entwickelt hat.

Unsere Teams arbeiten datengetrieben, um ihre eigene Produktivität ständig zu optimieren. Jedes Teammitglied übernimmt die “end-to-end” Verantwortung für seine Arbeit. Um erfolgreich zu sein, muss man produktiv sein. Um produktiv zu sein, muss man effizient und effektiv sein.

Technology never rests. Neither do we.

title: Senior Frontend Engineer - React
description: ResearchGate is the professional network for scientists and researchers. From climate change and emerging diseases to food security and the responsible development of AI, the challenges facing our world are complex. Still, we’re optimistic about the power of millions of scientists working together to tackle them. We provide scientists with the help and support they need by connecting them to the world’s most active scientific community. We've built a platform that gives the world's scientists the tools and services they need to connect, collaborate, and advance their research. Over 25 million members from 193 countries use ResearchGate to share, discover, and discuss research. Objective of the role We're looking for an enthusiastic frontend engineer with the skills and ability to turn great ideas into reality. You should have an in-depth understanding of current web technologies and front-end development, and be passionate about creating a great user experience. Your input will help us grow and maintain our React front-end. Join a team that encourages you to explore, learn, and go beyond, while seeing your work lead to actionable results. Put your creative problem-solving and development skills into action and make a positive impact on science and society. This is a full-time position based in Germany. The team You will be an integral part of the product team dedicated to enhancing ResearchGate's publisher-facing product. This role involves designing, constructing, and refining the platform to further our mission of facilitating global scientific connections and ensuring open access to research. At present, our team is working on making ResearchGate a great platform for publishers to connect with existing and future authors. Your immediate colleagues will consist of JavaScript and PHP engineers, an Engineering Manager, a Product Manager, a UX Designer, and a UX Writer. Our team places great value on our collaborative and communicative work culture and we eagerly anticipate integrating a new Engineer into this environment. Responsibilites Create web interfaces using TypeScript and React for new products and features. Seamlessly integrate our front-end with our back-end world using GraphQL and PHP. Maintain and improve existing features and related infrastructure. Collaborate with Product Managers, Designers, and Software Engineers to deliver compelling publisher-facing products. Requirements 5+ years frontend web development experience in TypeScript (React), CSS Demonstrated ability to create code that is easily comprehensible, maintainable, and testable. Eagerness to acquire new skills, delve into different technologies and programming languages, and a willingness to acknowledge areas where expertise may be lacking. Approach problem-solving thoughtfully, embracing curiosity and maintaining an open-minded perspective. You are comfortable incorporating AI-assisted development tools into your daily workflow and exercise strong engineering judgment when evaluating and refining their output. Knowledge of GraphQL. It would be a plus if you already had knowledge of relational and document-based databases (we use MongoDB and Postgres). What we're looking for You take responsibility over your own solutions and continuously improve them. You engage in proactive and efficient communication within our distributed work environment. You focus on building a great product. You excel at designing and creating coherent, user-centric interfaces that display complex information. The interview process We start with a short call with HR or an Engineering Manager to align on the details of the job inquiry. There will be a longer discussion about your technical and professional experience and expectations with an Engineering Manager and another colleague. We’ll facilitate a technical interview with one or two engineers with some pair programming and technical discussion. You'll have a conversation with our VP of Product, Mark, and our VP of Engineering, Frank, to learn more about our product and engineering organization and discuss how your experience aligns with our goals. Last but not least, you will meet with our CEO, Ijad, and our VP of Finance & People team, Jess. Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Graphene Device Physics Modeling Expert (f/m/d)
description: About us We see the semiconductor industry as a realm of possibility. We see opportunity. We see the profound impact that our graphene solutions will have in transforming the industry. We invite you to join us in driving change with our fundamentally human-centered approach, uniting bright minds around a shared vision. The vision is: Prove to everybody that you can make a fundamental change. Prove with your knowledge and skills how things can be done differently. Together, we can change the paradigm of how the world connects About our technology The semiconductor industry’s growing demand for more powerful chips with higher bandwidth and lower power finds its solution in our technology. We connect chips to high-throughput, low-delay computing networks. The key lies in harnessing the physical properties of graphene to combine electronic computing with photonic communication, allowing countless chips to interact almost as if they were one. Our graphene photonic innovation increases computing power and efficiency to a new order of magnitude In short, we connect chips to create powerful and energy-efficient networks, overcoming connectivity limitations in the semiconductor industry. We deliver the graphene solution The Role We are looking for a Graphene Device Physics Modeling Expert, to develop and refine physics based models for graphene photonic devices. Working at the intersection of research and software development you will translate state-of-the-art research into reliable simulation capabilities that support device design and development. To join our team, you should be excited to: Research the literature on state-of-the-art approaches to graphene device modeling and simulation Work with commercial TCAD and multiphysics simulation tools Translate physical models from scientific literature into robust, maintainable Python code Develop and extend models for graphene-based photonic devices, incorporating new physical effects and functionalities Calibrate, validate, and refine models using experimental characterization data Collaborate closely with various teams, prioritizing modeling activities in line with team and company goals Document your work clearly and contribute to shared software-development practices Your Qualifications PhD in Physics, Materials Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related field Strong foundation in solid-state physics, semiconductor physics, and mathematics Proficient in modeling techniques and methodologies for semiconductor physics Proven ability to translate scientific literature and mathematical models into simulation code Experience with TCAD development Proficiency in Python and Git Experience solving partial differential equations, particularly for charge and heat transport Experience with graphene and photonics Experience with commercial simulation tools such as COMSOL Multiphysics or Ansys Lumerical is a plus Our work culture People Over Processes. Your peace of mind is our priority - in the present and future We Live Openness. Collaboration and inclusivity are the cornerstones of our culture. We practice openness, fostering trust and respect. Individuality is our collective strength, fueling innovation and driving us forward We connect chips – and people. We encourage qualified individuals from any background to apply. We foster an inclusive and supportive work environment that values collaboration, innovation, and growth. Join our team and be part of an organization dedicated to making a difference in the industry Can you picture yourself in this Role and our Company? Let’s connect! title: Senior Scrum Master
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>At Hudl, we build great teams. We hire the best of the best to ensure you’re working with people you can constantly learn from. You’re trusted to get your work done your way while testing the limits of what’s possible and what’s next. We work hard to provide a culture where everyone feels supported, and our employees feel it—their votes helped us become one of the <a href="https://www.hudl.com/blog/hudl-2026-top-100-inspiring-workplaces?utm_medium=internal&amp;utm_source=job-ad&amp;utm_campaign=26_NA_talent_job-ad&amp;utm_content=1org_learn-more_blog-link_learn-more_2blog_organic_3ctw">Top 100 Inspiring Workplaces</a>.<br><br>We think of ourselves as the team behind the team, supporting the lifelong impact sports can have: the lessons in teamwork and dedication; the influence of inspiring coaches; and the opportunities to reach new heights. That’s why we help teams from all over the world see their game differently. Our products make it easier for coaches and athletes at any level to capture video, analyze data, share highlights and more.<br><br>Ready to join us?</p> <div style="padding: 56.25% 0 0 0; position: relative;"><iframe style="position: absolute; top: 0; left: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%; border: 0;" src="https://player.vimeo.com/video/1095624224?h=9e8cdc9dbe&amp;badge=0&amp;autopause=0&amp;player_id=0&amp;app_id=58479" width="" height=""></iframe></div> <p>&nbsp;</p></div><h2>Your Role</h2> <p>We're looking for a Senior Scrum Master to join our team in London. Our products help the world's top teams and athletes perform at their best. We need an experienced Agile leader to help the squads building them do the same.</p> <p>As a Senior ScrumMaster, you'll:</p> <ul> <li><strong>Coach the system, not just the team.</strong> You'll guide squads toward high autonomy while focusing on broader organizational design issues, such as resolving friction across business units, managing dependencies, and establishing scaling patterns.</li> <li><strong>Architect outcomes, not processes.</strong> You'll move fluidly across frameworks, adapting events to what the team needs to deliver value. You will act as an outcome architect, designing information flow and decision rhythms rather than functioning as a framework fundamentalist.</li> <li><strong>Anticipate, not react.</strong> You'll utilize predictive delivery intelligence and cross-team dependency mapping to resolve impediments before they surface, keeping coordination moving in the right direction even as the pace of delivery accelerates.</li> <li><strong>Foster psychological safety.</strong> You'll build environments where candor is safe, failure is treated as a data point, and conflict is constructive. You'll ensure teams feel secure enough to take on hard problems and navigate the shifting dynamics brought on by AI-assisted development.</li> <li><strong>Align and design for visibility.</strong> You'll map value streams to see where decisions stall and design cross-BU communication layers. You will maintain the signal through the noise, ensuring stakeholders know what's changed and what decisions are needed.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Location</strong></h2> <p>Time spent collaborating with your teammates in-office will be a regular part of how you work. We're currently considering applicants within commuting distance of our London office. You'll be expected to work more days in-office than remote, but will have the freedom to coordinate your specific in-office schedule with your team.</p> <h2>Must-Haves</h2> <ul> <li><strong>An experienced Agile practitioner. </strong>You have three or more years as a Scrum Master and have guided squads to improved, sustainable results and can scale your coaching capacity to influence broader organizational maturity.</li> <li><strong>A systems thinker.</strong> You see beyond the squad level, actively identifying and breaking down siloed organizational designs to reduce friction and eliminate duplicated efforts across Business Units.</li> <li><strong>Data-driven and predictive. </strong>You know how to use both qualitative and quantitative signals to establish predictive metrics that forecast delivery risk and guide investment decisions.</li> <li><strong>A clear communicator.</strong> You design lightweight operating guardrails and information flows that keep dependencies transparent and align stakeholders at every level without creating overhead that slows teams down.</li> <li><strong>A champion of responsible speed.</strong> You optimize for quality, anticipated dependencies, commitments kept, and team sustainability, ensuring that the speed of code generation never outpaces our coordination speed.</li> </ul> <h2>Nice-to-Haves</h2> <ul> <li><strong>AI fluency.</strong> You have an interest in or experience with AI-assisted development tools and AI-powered agile tools, such as automated bottleneck detection or real-time sentiment and health monitoring.</li> <li><strong>A diverse Agile toolbelt. </strong>You're familiar with multiple frameworks (Kanban, Lean, SAFe, etc) and know when and how to blend them for better outcomes.</li> <li><strong>Global team experience. </strong>Our product teams span the U.S. and Europe, and you're comfortable collaborating across time zones and cultures.</li> </ul> <h2>Our Role</h2> <ul> <li><strong>Champion work-life harmony.</strong> We'll give you the flexibility you need in your work life (e.g., flexible vacation time above any required statutory leave, company-wide holidays, remote work options and more) so you can enjoy your personal life too. Plus, every five years, we give you a paid sabbatical to unplug and recharge.</li> <li><strong>Guarantee autonomy.</strong> We have an open, honest culture and we trust our people from day one. Your team will support you, but you'll own your work and have the agency to try new ideas.</li> <li><strong>Encourage career growth.</strong> We're lifelong learners who encourage professional development. We'll give you tons of resources and opportunities to keep growing.</li> <li><strong>Provide an environment to help you succeed.</strong> We've invested in our offices, designing incredible spaces with our employees in mind. But whether you're at the office or working remotely, we'll provide you the tech you need to do your best work.</li> <li><strong>Support your wellbeing.</strong> Depending on location, we offer medical and retirement benefits for employees—but no matter where you're located, we have resources like our Employee Assistance Program and employee resource groups to support your mental health.</li> </ul> <h2>Compensation</h2><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p>The base salary range for this role is displayed below—<strong>starting salaries will typically fall near the middle of this range.</strong></p> <p>We make compensation decisions based on an individual's experience, skills and education in line with our internal pay equity practices.&nbsp;</p> <p>This role will also be eligible for a long-term incentive (LTI) award. Any bonuses awarded are based on individual and company performance paid at Hudl's discretion.&nbsp;</p></div><div class="title">Base Salary Range</div><div class="pay-range"><span>£48,000</span><span class="divider">&mdash;</span><span>£80,000 GBP</span></div></div></div><div class="content-conclusion"><h2><strong>Privacy Policy</strong></h2> <p><strong><a href="https://www.hudl.com/jobs/hudl-applicant-and-candidate-privacy-policy"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Hudl Applicant and Candidate Privacy Policy</span></a><br><br></strong></p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

You’ll own the overall match-3 gameplay experience, helping to define how the puzzle game feels to play while delivering best-in-class levels that strike the right balance of challenge, progression and delight. From core gameplay tuning and mechanic development through to polished, data-informed level iterations, you’ll take ownership of the player experience and continually raise the quality bar. You’ll work closely with game designers, artists, developers and analysts to ensure the match-3 is satisfying, intuitive and rewarding, evolving its mechanics, pacing and feel so that the game’s creative vision and long-term engagement goals come through. You’ll use player feedback, analytics and playtesting to refine gameplay, experiment with new ideas and shape the ongoing evolution of the game’s core puzzle experience. As a senior member of the team, you’ll also help shape our level production strategy, driving quality with both internal development and external partners while contributing to the long-term direction of the game. What You'll Be Doing Design, build and balance exceptional match-3 levels that deliver engaging gameplay across a wide range of player skill levels. Collaborate with developers to tune game feel and match 3 gameplay to be best-in-class Own the design of blockers, boosters and rewards and shape satisfying level progression Use analytics, player feedback and playtesting to continuously refine levels and improve player experience. Work alongside Engineering to improve level design tools, workflows and implementation processes. Partner with Art to ensure levels are visually readable, aesthetically cohesive and support the game’s creative vision. Plan and own Match 3 content production, ensuring a consistent pipeline of high-quality content that supports development milestones and LiveOps. Lead external level design contractors and outsourcing partners by providing clear briefs, regular feedback and quality reviews, ensuring all delivered content meets Treefrog’s standards. Mentor other designers through feedback, knowledge sharing and collaborative problem solving. What You Have Experience shipping successful free-to-play match-3 or puzzle games. Experience designing LiveOps events, seasonal content or limited-time game modes. Strong understanding of player progression, retention, engagement and monetisation in puzzle. Experience improving level editors, pipelines or content creation workflows. Experience leading small feature teams or mentoring designers. Have a deep understanding of the competition and genre trends. Passion for cosy games and creating emotionally engaging player experiences. A self-starter approach to use AI: you've found ways to use it in your day-to-day work, you experiment, figure things out and bring the same energy to every new challenge. What We're Looking for A strong sense of ownership, with the ability to drive work forward autonomously. A consistent track record of delivering high-quality work that meets design requirements and project goals. A proactive mindset, with the ability to identify opportunities and solve problems. Sound judgement in balancing creative excellence with production efficiency. The ability to lead external partners with clarity, empathy and high standards. A collaborative approach to sharing knowledge, mentoring designers and raising the team’s quality bar. Clear communication skills and the confidence to constructively challenge decisions. A player-first mindset, balanced with an understanding of creative, technical and commercial goals. A commitment to fostering a collaborative, inclusive and positive team culture. We’re looking for a talented and highly experienced Senior Match-3 Designer (internally Game Designer) to join our lovely and ambitious game team and help craft fun, rewarding and memorable puzzle experiences for our cozy mobile game.

You’ll own the overall match-3 gameplay experience, helping to define how the puzzle game feels to play while delivering best-in-class levels that strike the right balance of challenge, progression and delight. From core gameplay tuning and mechanic development through to polished, data-informed level iterations, you’ll take ownership of the player experience and continually raise the quality bar.

You’ll work closely with game designers, artists, developers and analysts to ensure the match-3 is satisfying, intuitive and rewarding, evolving its mechanics, pacing and feel so that the game’s creative vision and long-term engagement goals come through. You’ll use player feedback, analytics and playtesting to refine gameplay, experiment with new ideas and shape the ongoing evolution of the game’s core puzzle experience.

As a senior member of the team, you’ll also help shape our level production strategy, driving quality with both internal development and external partners while contributing to the long-term direction of the game.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Design, build and balance exceptional match-3 levels that deliver engaging gameplay across a wide range of player skill levels.

  • Collaborate with developers to tune game feel and match 3 gameplay to be best-in-class

  • Own the design of blockers, boosters and rewards and shape satisfying level progression

  • Use analytics, player feedback and playtesting to continuously refine levels and improve player experience.

  • Work alongside Engineering to improve level design tools, workflows and implementation processes.

  • Partner with Art to ensure levels are visually readable, aesthetically cohesive and support the game’s creative vision.

  • Plan and own Match 3 content production, ensuring a consistent pipeline of high-quality content that supports development milestones and LiveOps.

    • Lead external level design contractors and outsourcing partners by providing clear briefs, regular feedback and quality reviews, ensuring all delivered content meets Treefrog’s standards.

  • Mentor other designers through feedback, knowledge sharing and collaborative problem solving.

What You Have

  • Experience shipping successful free-to-play match-3 or puzzle games.

  • Experience designing LiveOps events, seasonal content or limited-time game modes.

  • Strong understanding of player progression, retention, engagement and monetisation in puzzle.

  • Experience improving level editors, pipelines or content creation workflows.

  • Experience leading small feature teams or mentoring designers.

  • Have a deep understanding of the competition and genre trends.

  • Passion for cosy games and creating emotionally engaging player experiences.

  • A self-starter approach to use AI: you've found ways to use it in your day-to-day work, you experiment, figure things out and bring the same energy to every new challenge.

What We're Looking for

  • A strong sense of ownership, with the ability to drive work forward autonomously.

  • A consistent track record of delivering high-quality work that meets design requirements and project goals.

  • A proactive mindset, with the ability to identify opportunities and solve problems.

  • Sound judgement in balancing creative excellence with production efficiency.

  • The ability to lead external partners with clarity, empathy and high standards.

  • A collaborative approach to sharing knowledge, mentoring designers and raising the team’s quality bar.

  • Clear communication skills and the confidence to constructively challenge decisions.

  • A player-first mindset, balanced with an understanding of creative, technical and commercial goals.

  • A commitment to fostering a collaborative, inclusive and positive team culture.

Where You'll Be

This role is based in our London office. The team values in-person collaboration and typically works from the office three days a week: Mondays, Tuesdays and Fridays.

About Supercell

Supercell is a games company from Helsinki, Finland, with offices also in San Francisco, Seoul, Shanghai, and London. You might know us as the makers of Hay Day, Clash of Clans, Boom Beach, Clash Royale, and Brawl Stars. Our mission is to create great games that as many people as possible play for years and that are remembered forever.

So, how do we make great games? By putting together the best teams and giving them the freedom and independence to succeed. And by taking risks, failing, sharing learnings, and killing lots of projects.

description: <p>Scopely is looking for a QA Director to join our Stumble Guys team in our Barcelona or Dundee hubs, working in a hybrid mode 3 days from the hub.</p> <p>At Scopely, we care deeply about what we do and want to inspire play, every day - whether in our work environments alongside our talented colleagues, or through our deep connections with our communities of players. We are a global team of game lovers who are developing, publishing and innovating the mobile games industry, connecting millions of people around the world daily.&nbsp;</p> <p>Stumble Guys is a global sensation, with millions of fans joining the party every single day and with the ambition of becoming nothing less than a beloved franchise to be played for many years to come.</p> <p><strong>What You Will Do&nbsp;</strong></p> <p>You will collaborate and coordinate with peers, senior management and external partners, to ensure operations are aligned with the departmental mission, values, and long-term strategic goals as well as ensuring continued service improvements are implemented throughout the world on behalf of Scopely QA &amp; Deployment.&nbsp;</p> <p>You will help shape the future on how we continue to iterate and evolve our products at a high level, while ensuring our products delight our players release after release. Deployment Project Owners and their teams, using clear objectives, quality metrics and stakeholder feedback to guide coaching, development and performance improvement.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What We’re Looking For </strong><strong><br></strong></p> <ul> <li>10 + years as a quality assurance professional</li> <li>6 + years management experience in leading a team through a full game cycle</li> <li>Excellent written/verbal communication in English</li> <li>Experience in building and managing a QA organization that is responsible for end-to-end validation for a critical system or application</li> <li>Demonstrated experience managing external QA vendors, including setting delivery expectations, assessing performance and driving service improvements, alongside a strong understanding of Dev QA and external testing strategies.</li> <li>Experience working with remote teams and with a cross functional team that is distributed around the globe</li> <li>Experience and ease in interfacing with Senior Management, working to develop and maintain strong, effective relationships across the organization</li> <li>Exceptional attention to detail and ability to multitask under pressure of hard deadlines</li> <li>Demonstrated experience managing bug defect solutions &amp; creating test plans</li> <li>Strong understanding of software development (SDLC) practices &amp; nomenclature, quality assurance techniques, frameworks and methodologies</li> <li>Flexible and dynamic – quickly adapt to changing needs of the business</li> <li>Good understanding of the current and evolving landscape of AI-powered testing tools, and experience driving the transition from manual testing approaches to AI-native.</li> <li>Business awareness - the ability to view situations from a business perspective</li> <li>Proficient with setting up and navigating through bug database management, test case management tools, Google Docs, Google Sheets/Excel, and a build distribution management system (AppLivery), JIRA</li> <li>Mobile Freemium/F2P gaming experience</li> </ul> <p><strong>Bonus Points&nbsp;</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience with Console and PC deployment &amp; compliance.</li> <li>Any experience with Localization, LQA, build distribution and submissions&nbsp;</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p>&nbsp;</p> <h3>About Scopely</h3> <p>Scopely is a leading video game and global interactive entertainment company, home to many of the world’s most beloved and enduring experiences, including two of the most successful mobile games of all-time “MONOPOLY GO!” and “Pokémon GO,” along with “Stumble Guys,” “Star Trek™ Fleet Command,” “MARVEL Strike Force,” “WWE Champions,” the Scrabble® franchise, “Yahtzee® With Buddies,” and many others. We pride ourselves on finding the most efficient and effective ways to deliver the most valuable results for the company. As a System Test Engineer, HIL, you’ll build robust, reusable automation and work across engineering disciplines to improve coverage, reliability and traceability.
