raw.title: System Test Automation Engineer
raw.description:
Before the detail, here's the challenge you'd help us solve.

We build the embodied intelligence that moves real vehicles safely, and the ecosystem a billion machines will run on in the future. Very few people in AI can say this. Every role here, whatever the team, plugs into that.

Here’s what this particular role covers.

🛠️ About our Verification and Release Test Team

Wayve’s Verification and Release Test team sits at the intersection of hardware, embedded software and machine learning models. Our testing spans component, system and vehicle levels, and we build novel test automation in-house to identify issues earlier in development. We pride ourselves on finding the most efficient and effective ways to deliver the most valuable results for the company.

As a System Test Engineer, HIL, you’ll build robust, reusable automation and work across engineering disciplines to improve coverage, reliability and traceability. This is a hands-on delivery role with room to grow into broader areas of the system, including sensing and model-behaviour testing, as Wayve and your experience evolve.

🧠 Your day-to-day

  • Develop automation for system functionality tests at component, integration and system levels, working across software and hardware boundaries.

  • Lead root-cause investigations for failures identified during test campaigns, collaborating with hardware, software, infrastructure and DevOps teams to resolve issues.

  • Analyse test results, uncover software and hardware bugs, and report findings through Jira with clear evidence to support debugging.

  • Optimise Buildkite CI/CD-integrated test workflows for rapid, reliable and repeatable execution.

  • Review, create and follow risk assessments to ensure all testing activities are conducted safely and responsibly.

🧩 What you’ll be working on:

  • Independently owning the design and delivery of automated verification for a defined area of our embedded software stack, steadily raising the bar on coverage, reliability and traceability.

  • Building open-loop and closed-loop hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) replay tests, alongside reliability and fault-injection tests, to support verification, release and debugging.

  • Automating HIL test setups and improving test infrastructure to expand coverage, make failures easier to trace and strengthen compliance reporting.

  • Integrating requirements, coverage and compliance workflows, including Jama, MC/DC coverage analysis and MISRA checks, and managing test artefacts through Artifactory and Azure.

  • Developing traceability dashboards and defining KPIs and quality metrics that support data-driven validation and release decisions.

🙌 You should apply if:

  • You have hands-on experience with system-level verification and validation in robotics, embedded software or mechatronic systems, with a track record of independently delivering test automation.

  • You’re highly proficient in Python and have experience developing automation test frameworks using pytest.

  • You’ve worked with HIL testing and tooling, including interfaces such as CAN, Ethernet or GMSL, and tools from dSPACE, Vector, Xylon or similar providers.

  • You understand open-loop and closed-loop HIL replay testing using dSPACE or other emulators.

  • You’re familiar with automotive safety and process standards, including ISO 26262, ASPICE and SOTIF, and have experience integrating requirements and test-management tools such as Jama and Xray.

  • You’re proficient in CI/CD principles and related tooling, such as GitLab CI, Buildkite and Bazel.

  • You have experience developing or testing automotive software at embedded and system levels, including hardware/software interactions and interface-level testing, and have worked with L2+ hands-off, L3 or L4 automated driving systems.

  • You have knowledge of consumer safety-rating protocols such as Euro NCAP, including AEB and LSS/LKA scenarios; DCAS regulatory testing under UN R171; and automotive cybersecurity testing and standards, including ISO/SAE 21434 and UN R155.

  • You’ve worked with test automation dashboards, logging and reporting infrastructure, using tools such as Grafana, Looker, Datadog and Jira.

  • You’re a self-starter with a sharp eye for improvement who communicates clearly and works effectively across software, hardware, autonomy, DevOps and product teams.

  • Ideally, you’ve contributed to improvements in test methods, safety procedures or operational efficiency, and are familiar with data management and version control tools such as Git.

  • Experience using agentic AI coding tools such as Cursor or Claude Code to accelerate and improve test development, debugging and automation workflows would also be valuable.

🌱 Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! If you’re passionate about autonomy and keen to learn, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every requirement.

More about Wayve:

🚀 Wayve is building the leading AI platform for autonomous driving. We are pioneering an end to end AI approach that enables vehicles to learn directly from real world experience, developing the ability to adapt, generalise and improve at scale. Instead of relying on hand coded rules or pre mapped environments, our AI Driver learns to drive by understanding the world around it. The result is technology that navigates complex urban environments with intelligence, precision and natural flow, unlocking meaningful advances in both safety and efficiency. We believe autonomy represents a once in a generation transformation in how people and goods move, comparable to the shift from horses to cars, and from human driven vehicles to intelligent machines.

Our ambition is to make autonomy universal. Wayve’s mapless and hardware agnostic AI platform integrates with global OEM partners, enabling continuous software evolution and unlocking advanced levels of automation from L2 plus through to L4 as our core AI model scales. In a race increasingly defined by intelligence and real world learning, Wayve is taking a distinct approach, building a generalisable driving intelligence that can power any vehicle, anywhere. By combining embodied AI with scalable deployment, we are creating technology that can be shaped to each OEM brand and driver experience, accelerating the transition to a safer, more intelligent future of mobility.

How we work 💻- Locations & Flexible Working:

Our main hubs are in London, Sunnyvale, Yokohama, Herzliya, Vancouver and Leonberg. We operate a hybrid working model that combines in-person collaboration in our dedicated office spaces with focused time working remotely. This gives our teams the connection and energy of working together, alongside the flexibility to do their best work in a way that fits their lives.

🔍 The Interview Process:

Our process is clear and respectful of your time:

  • Initial call / recruiter screen (30 minutes)

  • Competency Interviews (Programming and hiring manager interview; 1 hour 45 minutes total)

  • Deep-dive technical interviews (Cross-functional, system design; 1 hour 45 minutes total)

  • Final interview: mission & values alignment (45 minutes).

We’ll always explain the format and work around your availability.

What’s in it for you (Location dependant):

💰 Salaries benchmarked against the market annually
✅ Hybrid working, core hours and the chance to work hands on in vehicle workshops and labs
📚 Learning and development budgets with support for training, conferences and growth
🩺 Comprehensive benefits including health insurance, dental, enhanced maternity and paternity leave, retirement or pension where applicable, access to therapists, wellbeing partnerships, team socials and more

A quick, honest note before you apply.

Wayve is not a mature, fully-structured place with the playbook already written. Much of how we work is still being written, and if you join, you’ll help write it. That suits people who want real ownership more than people who need a settled structure from day one.

If that sounds like the kind of problem you want to spend your time on, we’d really like to hear from you.

At Wayve we're committed to creating a diverse, fair and respectful culture that is inclusive of everyone based on their unique skills and perspectives, and regardless of sex, race, religion or belief, ethnic or national origin, disability, age, citizenship, marital, domestic or civil partnership status, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, pregnancy or related condition (including breastfeeding) or any other basis as protected by applicable law.

In a world where media is everywhere and in everything, we bring the best platform, people, and partners together to create limitless opportunities for growth. For more information, visit wppmedia.com</p> <p>At WPP Media, we believe in the power of our culture and our people. It’s what elevates us to deliver exceptional experiences for both our clients and each other. In this role it will be critical to embrace WPP &amp; WPP Media’s shared core values:</p> <ul> <li>Be&nbsp;<strong>Extraordinary</strong>&nbsp;by&nbsp;<em>Leading Collectively</em>&nbsp;to&nbsp;<em>Inspire transformational Creativity.</em></li> <li>Create an&nbsp;<strong>Open</strong>&nbsp;environment by<em>&nbsp;Balancing People and Client Experiences</em>&nbsp;by&nbsp;<em>Cultivating Trust</em>.</li> <li>Lead&nbsp;<strong>Optimistically</strong>&nbsp;by&nbsp;<em>Championing Growth</em>&nbsp;<em>and Development</em>&nbsp;to&nbsp;<em>Mobilize the Enterprise</em>.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Role Summary and Impact</strong></p> <p>As one of our Directors in the Solutions Development team you will be focused specifically on leading the design and development for enhanced digital performance within WPP Media Solutions in ways that have client appeal and are revenue returning.</p> <p>With either extensive performance marketing, or in-platform performance experience in social and programmatic, you will canvas the broad responsibility of leading strategically on designing the destination and mapping the requirements, with tactical development planning to ensure we build, test, and launch with robust processes.</p> <p>Strategically, you will act as a forward-looking leader and innovation agent, shaping the future of performance within WPP Media Solutions and directly influencing our own path to delivering Guaranteed Outcomes to clients.</p> <p>Tactically, you will both lead cross-functional working groups to build, test and launch while also collaborating with marketing science, directly feeding into the rest of the portfolio – defining, evolving and championing lower funnel performance delivery for clients in line with our gold standard measurement and effectiveness framework.</p> <p>The role promises to offer you a platform for individual growth, matrix management of cross-functional teams across Data &amp; Tech, Solutions Integrations, Marketing Science, Planning, and Activation with a platform for true client and business impact.</p> <p><strong>&nbsp;</strong></p> <p><strong>Overall Purpose:</strong></p> <p>To lead, shape, and directly influence our lower funnel performance offer to clients – grounded in social and OR programmatic, with influence into the wider portfolio.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Responsibility set</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Performance planning &amp; Thought leader:</strong>Be the go-to expert for innovation and developments in Performance delivery for clients with a lens on Social and Programmatic Display, understanding competitive landscapes, and collaboratively shaping solution differentiation. Lead channel innovation leveraging our Desirability, Feasibility, Viability framework.</li> <li><strong>Cross-Functional leadership:</strong>Lead cross-functional working groups, bringing together diverse teams (media, tech, marketing science, planning, activation) to deliver prioritized developments and planned benefits. This involves being a project manager for complex initiatives.</li> <li><strong>Senior stakeholder engagement:</strong>Engage confidently with senior leaders and stakeholders to drive ideas, influence strategy, and articulate the value of proposed solutions.</li> <li><strong>Channel ecosystem understanding:</strong>Network with agency practitioners and EMEA colleagues to ensure a finely tuned understanding of how channels are planned, activated, and measured, driving solution consistency and identifying opportunities for share and reapply.</li> <li><strong>Commercial &amp; compliance oversight:</strong>Ensure the compliant design and development of owned channel solutions, continuously reviewing pricing, margin setting, and market fit. Maintain a deep understanding of the supply chain and cost model.</li> <li><strong>Roadmap &amp; delivery:</strong>Develop and deliver a channel roadmap, manage solution materials, and troubleshoot business challenges to ensure an enhanced and integrated portfolio of solutions.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Skills and Experience</strong></p> <ul> <li>10+ years with performance marketing experience in Media, with proof points in Performance, Social and OR Programmatic trading.</li> <li>Evidenced experience and understanding of Digital Media, both from a media and technical perspective with strong relationships with adtech/martech partners to enable solution development</li> <li>Performance Marketing craft knowledge and industry POV is important.</li> <li>An entrepreneurial attitude with a portfolio of experiences to showcase ability to recognise and develop new client solutions ahead of market maturity</li> <li>Accredited or can speak to project management experience to effectively manage cross-functional teams and associated developments</li> <li>Confidence and Ability to manage and deliver multiple projects to multiple deadlines simultaneously</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>&nbsp;<strong>Life at WPP Media &amp; Benefits</strong></p> <p>Our passion for shaping the next era of media includes investing in our employees to help them do their best work, and we’re just as committed to employee growth as we are to responsible media investment. Our benefits include competitive medical, group retirement plans, vision, and dental insurance, significant paid time off, preferential partner discounts, and employee mental health awareness days.&nbsp;&nbsp;</p> <p>WPP Media is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to characteristics. title: Chief of Staff to the CEO
description: <p><strong><a href="https://foundation.mozilla.org/en/">Mozilla Foundation</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;"><strong> </strong>is a non-profit building a better technology future — powered by people, open by design, fueled by imagination.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We deliver people-first alternatives to today’s extractive systems. We build side by side with developers, innovators and advocates, united in the belief that a better technology future is not only possible — it’s ours to create!</span></p> <h2><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong>Team</strong></span></h2> <p><a href="https://www.mozillafoundation.org/en/meet-mozilla/nabiha-syed/"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Our CEO</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> is increasingly focused outward on the Board, funders, partners, and public conversations that will shape the Foundation’s next chapter. This newly created Chief of Staff role exists to extend the CEO’s reach inside the organization and make that outward focus possible.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Reporting directly to the CEO, you’ll serve as the CEO’s strategic partner, internal proxy and trusted extension of their leadership. You’ll hold the CEO’s strategic agenda, translate the CEO’s priorities into organizational alignment, represent the CEO internally where needed, and make decisions on the CEO’s behalf within clearly delegated authority. You’ll determine what reaches the CEO, prepare the CEO for consequential moments, and escalate only what requires the CEO’s judgment.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">As a member of the Executive Leadership Team, you’ll partner strategically with other members of the ELT and work closely with the CEO’s Executive Program Manager to make sure the CEO’s time, priorities, and commitments stay aligned and moving.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">You’ll also partner with the Foundation’s Investment Committee and its technical and strategic advisors, keeping their focus on the right questions, their recommendations aligned with the Foundation’s strategic priorities, and decisions moving efficiently from evaluation to funding.</span></p> <h2><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong>Job responsibilities</strong></span></h2> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Here’s what you’ll likely be focused on for the <span style="text-decoration: underline;">first 6 months</span>:</span></p> <ul> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Building a strong working partnership with the CEO, aligning on priorities, ways of working and clearly defining the scope of your delegated authority.</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Establishing a trusted partnership with each member of the Executive Leadership Team, learning their priorities, pressures and ways of working.</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Developing a deep, cross-functional understanding of the Foundation’s work and how each function connects to the CEO’s priorities.</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Translating the CEO’s priorities into a concise, clear set of strategic outcomes that leaders understand and can use to guide the decisions they own, with a current view of what’s changing and which decisions are approaching.</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Defining with the CEO what truly requires their attention, and ensuring issues reach them decision-ready, with context, options and a recommendation.</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Getting up to speed with the Investment Committee and its advisors, and helping keep their focus on the right questions so decisions move efficiently from evaluation to funding.</span></li> </ul> <p><strong>As the Chief of Staff to Mozilla Foundation’s CEO, you will…</strong></p> <ul> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Serve as the CEO’s thought partner in developing, pressure-testing and refining strategic priorities, synthesizing executive insight and external developments to anticipate what will need to be known or decided in the next 30, 60 and 90 days.</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Direct the CEO’s time toward strategy, external relationships, development, Board leadership and the Foundation’s highest-consequence decisions.</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Filter rather than forward, so significant shifts in strategy, material risks, major budget decisions and Board-level matters reach the CEO early, with context, options and a recommendation.</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Maintain a current view of the CEO’s top priorities, identify where work is drifting from strategic intent, and surface conflicts in priorities, resources or attention before they become emergencies.</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Enable the Executive Leadership Team to operate as one team around the CEO’s priorities, so the right issues reach the ELT at the right level and decisions and commitments are followed through.</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Partner with ELT members on cross-functional issues that need CEO-level alignment but not the CEO’s direct involvement.</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Represent the CEO’s position in internal discussions and make decisions on the CEO’s behalf within delegated authority, bringing anything beyond it back to the CEO promptly.</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Ensure the CEO enters every Board meeting, funder and partner conversation, speech and public engagement fully prepared, with concise briefings, organizational context and answers to likely questions.</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Identify external opportunities that warrant the CEO’s attention, and ensure commitments the CEO makes externally translate into clear internal follow-through.</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Steward alignment between the Investment Committee’s work and the Foundation’s strategy: keep its technical and strategic advisors focused on the right questions, surface gaps, risks or competing views, and bring forward matters that need the CEO’s judgment.</span></li> </ul> <p><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong>What this role is not</strong></span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">This is a role of influence. It exists to ensure the CEO can lead effectively through the Executive Leadership Team.</span></p> <ul> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">The Chief of Staff does not manage the Executive Leadership Team or run the Foundation’s operations. Each executive leader owns execution and decisions within their area.</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">This role does not make decisions beyond the authority the CEO has delegated. Anything outside that authority returns to the CEO.</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">This role does not have any direct reports and also doesn’t manage the CEO’s calendar, scheduling or administrative support.</span></li> </ul> <h2><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong>Your Professional Profile</strong></span></h2> <ul> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Significant, verifiable experience as a strategic partner at CEO or executive-team level, with a track record of leading high-stakes work and turning ambiguity into structure and action.</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Experience working across multiple legal entities is a plus, including navigating differences, building influence, and coordinating work across entities where relevant.&nbsp;</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">A proven record of driving complex, cross-functional priorities from idea to execution by defining outcomes, ownership, milestones and decision points.</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Exceptional judgment and discretion, including handling confidential information and navigating complex executive dynamics with integrity.</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Demonstrated ability to influence without formal authority, build trust across functions and at the most senior levels, and give direct feedback with care.</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Outstanding written and verbal communication, with experience distilling complex information into decision-ready briefs, recommendations, presentations and executive communications.</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Strong analytical and strategic problem-solving skills: you frame the right question, gather the right information, test assumptions and recommend a practical path forward.</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Disciplined prioritization, with the agility to move between long-term priorities and time-sensitive issues without losing the thread.</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Direct experience supporting Board governance, fundraising or other high-stakes external relationships at an executive level.</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">A track record of doing high-impact work out of the spotlight, measuring your success by the CEO’s and the team’s, and acting in the best interests of the CEO and the organization.</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">A demonstrated commitment to Mozilla Foundation’s mission and to building an open, accessible and trustworthy internet.</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">The ability to work across time zones and occasionally outside standard working hours for Board meetings, major events or urgent organizational needs.</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Comfortable traveling for Board meetings, leadership gatherings and major events.</span></li> </ul> <p><strong>We Are Excited To See Any Additional Experience With:</strong></p> <ul> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Senior roles in nonprofit, philanthropic, technology or public-interest organizations.</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Supporting or advising investment, grantmaking or funding committees.</span></li> </ul> <h2><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong>How We Work</strong></span></h2> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">A few things that are true about how we work at Mozilla Foundation. Here's a summary along with our expectation of how these should show up in this role:</span></p> <ul> <li><strong>Move toward the hard thing</strong>: you surface conflicts in priorities, resources or attention early, and give the CEO and executives direct, actionable input, including what they may not want to hear. You disagree constructively in the room, not afterward, and you don’t wait for someone else to raise it.</li> <li><strong>Stay curious and current</strong>:&nbsp;you stay close to what executives are seeing and what’s happening in our fields and communities, and turn it into the context the CEO needs. You pressure-test assumptions, including your own.</li> <li><strong>Work in the open</strong>:&nbsp;you document decisions and the reasoning behind them, so executives and teams can follow how and why priorities are set. You favor shared channels over side conversations wherever appropriate.</li> <li><strong>Focus and finish</strong>:&nbsp;you keep the CEO’s agenda focused on what matters most, make deliberate choices about what does and doesn’t need the CEO, and make sure decisions and commitments are seen through.</li> <li><strong>Flex with purpose</strong>: you move between long-term priorities and time-sensitive issues as context shifts, and adapt how you work with each executive. Flexibility isn’t about being agreeable; it’s staying responsive while holding to the mission and the CEO’s priorities.</li> <li><strong>Lead with care</strong>:&nbsp;you hold a high bar for the work while treating people as whole humans. You extend good faith to fellow executives, respect that each owns their area, and talk directly to the person who can solve the problem.</li> </ul> <h2><span style="text-decoration: underline;">Salary and Benefits Information</span></h2> <p>Mozilla Foundation is dedicated to fair and equitable compensation for our staff. We aim to pay a competitive and market-based salary based on the responsibilities and requirements of the role. We do not ask for, or take into account, salary histories in our offer process.</p> <p>The starting salary ranges for this role are listed below.&nbsp;</p> <ul> <li>Germany: €206,448.00 – €232,253.22</li> <li>UK: £181,764.00 – £204,483.81</li> <li>Canada: $356,400.00 – $400,948.65</li> <li>US: $264,000.00 – $296,999.00</li> </ul> <p>We also offer the following benefits:</p> <ul> <li>Private Medical Insurance</li> <li>Extended Sick Leave</li> <li>Global Employee Assistance Program (EAP)</li> <li>Retirement Plan contributions</li> <li>Paid Time Off: 20 days annual leave + sick days and your birthday</li> <li>Company Holidays + EOY Shutdown</li> <li>Wellness budget</li> <li>Professional Development budget</li> <li>Top up program for Pregnancy and Parental leaves</li> </ul> <p><em>Benefits are subject to change at any time at the discretion of Mozilla Foundation.</em></p> <h2><span style="text-decoration: underline;">Mozilla Foundation Hiring Practices</span></h2> <p>Mozilla understands that valuing diverse creative practices and forms of knowledge are crucial to and enrich the company’s core mission. We encourage applications from everyone, including members of all equity-seeking communities, such as (but certainly not limited to) women, racialized and Indigenous persons, persons with disabilities, and persons of all sexual orientations and gender identities and expressions.</p> <p>We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.</p> <p>We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. title: International Data Acquisition Manager
description: Why Socure? Socure is building the identity trust infrastructure for the digital economy — verifying 100% of good identities in real time and stopping fraud before it starts. The mission is big, the problems are complex, and the impact is felt by businesses, governments, and millions of people every day. We hire people who want that level of responsibility. People who move fast, think critically, act like owners, and care deeply about solving customer problems with precision. If you want predictability or narrow scope, this won’t be your place. If you want to help build the future of identity with a team that holds a high bar for itself — keep reading. As an International Data Acquisition Manager at Socure, you will be instrumental in expanding and managing our global data assets to power Socure’s identity verification, fraud prevention, and compliance solutions. Your primary focus will be sourcing, evaluating, onboarding, and managing third-party data providers across international markets, with a strong emphasis on data quality, operational scalability, and regulatory compliance. Reporting to the Head of Data Acquisition and Strategy, you will collaborate closely with the Product, Data Science, Engineering, Legal, Compliance, and external data partners. Together, you will identify and operationalize data sources to enhance product performance, broaden geographic reach, and drive Socure’s international growth. This role is especially critical as Socure deepens its international investments, building in-region capabilities and expanding its product support in the EU, UK, LATAM, and other key markets. What You'll Do Vendor and Data Management Support the evaluation, onboarding, and ongoing management of third-party data vendors across multiple international markets and product lines, ensuring alignment with business priorities and needs. Assist in preparing RFIs, RFPs, diligence materials, and vendor assessments to evaluate provider capabilities, data quality, compliance posture, operational fit, and commercial value. Maintain clear, auditable documentation regarding purchased data, vendor status, usage rights, contractual constraints, and performance across the data acquisition lifecycle. Help manage renewals and identify new vendors to improve product quality, expand coverage, and enhance cost efficiency. Collaboration and Internationalization Strategy Research and evaluate new international data sources aligned with Socure’s strategic priorities, particularly for identity verification, fraud prevention, KYC/eKYC, Document Verification, and compliance use cases. Develop a deep understanding of Socure products and international scenarios to assess the relevance, incremental value, and risks of potential data sources. Partner with Product, Data Science, Engineering, Legal, Compliance, and Procurement to align on priorities, plan integrations, and ensure effective operationalization of new data sources. Contribute to data acquisition that promotes inclusivity, coverage, and fairness in identity verification across diverse populations and regions. Represent the Data Acquisition team in cross-functional meetings, clearly communicating findings, trade-offs, and recommendations to technical and non-technical stakeholders. raw.title: International Data Acquisition Manager
raw.description:
Why Socure?

Socure is building the identity trust infrastructure for the digital economy — verifying 100% of good identities in real time and stopping fraud before it starts. The mission is big, the problems are complex, and the impact is felt by businesses, governments, and millions of people every day.

We hire people who want that level of responsibility. People who move fast, think critically, act like owners, and care deeply about solving customer problems with precision. If you want predictability or narrow scope, this won’t be your place. If you want to help build the future of identity with a team that holds a high bar for itself — keep reading.

As an International Data Acquisition Manager at Socure, you will be instrumental in expanding and managing our global data assets to power Socure’s identity verification, fraud prevention, and compliance solutions. Your primary focus will be sourcing, evaluating, onboarding, and managing third-party data providers across international markets, with a strong emphasis on data quality, operational scalability, and regulatory compliance.

 

Reporting to the Head of Data Acquisition and Strategy, you will collaborate closely with the Product, Data Science, Engineering, Legal, Compliance, and external data partners. Together, you will identify and operationalize data sources to enhance product performance, broaden geographic reach, and drive Socure’s international growth.

 

This role is especially critical as Socure deepens its international investments, building in-region capabilities and expanding its product support in the EU, UK, LATAM, and other key markets.

 

What You'll Do

Vendor and Data Management

  • Support the evaluation, onboarding, and ongoing management of third-party data vendors across multiple international markets and product lines, ensuring alignment with business priorities and needs.

  • Assist in preparing RFIs, RFPs, diligence materials, and vendor assessments to evaluate provider capabilities, data quality, compliance posture, operational fit, and commercial value.

  • Maintain clear, auditable documentation regarding purchased data, vendor status, usage rights, contractual constraints, and performance across the data acquisition lifecycle.

  • Help manage renewals and identify new vendors to improve product quality, expand coverage, and enhance cost efficiency.

 

Collaboration and Internationalization Strategy

  • Research and evaluate new international data sources aligned with Socure’s strategic priorities, particularly for identity verification, fraud prevention, KYC/eKYC, Document Verification, and compliance use cases.

  • Develop a deep understanding of Socure products and international scenarios to assess the relevance, incremental value, and risks of potential data sources.

  • Partner with Product, Data Science, Engineering, Legal, Compliance, and Procurement to align on priorities, plan integrations, and ensure effective operationalization of new data sources.

  • Contribute to data acquisition that promotes inclusivity, coverage, and fairness in identity verification across diverse populations and regions.

  • Represent the Data Acquisition team in cross-functional meetings, clearly communicating findings, trade-offs, and recommendations to technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Data Quality and Integration

  • Assist in due diligence for prospective data sources, including data quality assessments, overlap and coverage analysis, compliance reviews, and performance testing.

  • Support structured evaluations and proof-of-concept testing for new vendors and datasets using evidence-based methods to determine business value and product impact.

  • Monitor and report on data quality metrics, vendor performance, feed reliability, and issues such as drift, schema changes, or outages; help coordinate remediation as necessary.

  • Work with internal technical teams to plan integrations, including understanding schemas, APIs, delivery models, and operational dependencies.

Operational Excellence

  • Manage day-to-day operations across the international data acquisition lifecycle, including vendor communications, issue resolution, documentation, and follow-up on action items.

  • Track and document cost, usage, and value metrics for acquired datasets, supporting budgeting, renewals, prioritization, and vendor decisions.

  • Identify opportunities to streamline processes, improve evaluation frameworks, and scale the team’s operating model as international data needs expand.

What You Bring

  • 5+ years of experience in data acquisition, vendor management, procurement, partnerships, data operations, or a related field.

  • Experience evaluating or managing third-party data providers, ideally across multiple markets or jurisdictions.

  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to assess data quality, business value, and operational trade-offs.

  • Working knowledge of regulatory and privacy frameworks impacting data acquisition and usage, including UK GDPR, EU GDPR, and other relevant data protection requirements.

  • Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail, including experience maintaining structured documentation and evaluation records.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to collaborate across technical and non-technical teams.

  • Ability to manage shifting priorities and work effectively in a fast-paced, cross-functional environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working with data vendors in identity verification, fraud prevention, financial services, regtech, or compliance-related markets.

  • Familiarity with international identity, KYC/eKYC, or watchlist-related data ecosystems.

  • Knowledge of global data landscapes, including government, credit bureau, mobile network, utility, electoral, or equivalent data sources used in various countries.

  • Familiarity with data integration concepts, including APIs, batch delivery, schemas, and operationalizing external data feeds.

  • Experience using SQL or similar tools for data analysis, profiling, or evaluation.

  • Experience working with UK and European market data providers or supporting products in the UK and internationally.

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

As a Senior Engineer in the Infrastructure org, you will help evolve the cloud foundations behind every Samsara product. Your goal will be to reduce systemic production risk and enable continued growth by making infrastructure safer to change, easier to operate, and more resilient and cost-efficient at scale.

You will bring deep expertise in at least one infrastructure domain, such as compute and workload orchestration, networking, storage and stateful systems, or cloud control planes, and apply it across our multi-account, multi-region AWS environment. You will lead work such as modernizing compute and stateful infrastructure, strengthening capacity and failure isolation, and building standardized infrastructure-as-code workflows and reusable automation.

You will partner with product engineering teams to turn recurring risks and manual operations into durable platforms and paved paths. We do not expect you to be an expert in every infrastructure domain. We are looking for engineers who have built and operated critical systems at significant scale, understand how infrastructure fails, and can use that experience to improve both our platforms and our engineering practices.

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: The software, firmware, and hardware you build will result in real-world impact, helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
  • You are a life-long learner: We have ambitious goals. Every Samsarian has a growth mindset as we work with a wide range of technologies, challenges, and customers that push us to learn on the go.
  • You believe customers are more than a number: Samsara engineers enjoy a rare closeness to the end user and you will have the opportunity to participate in customer interviews, collaborate with customer success and product managers, and use metrics to ensure our work is translating into better customer outcomes.
  • You are a team player: Working on our Samsara Engineering teams requires a mix of independent effort and collaboration. Motivated by our mission, we're all racing toward our connected operations vision, and we intend to win together.

In this role, you will: 

  • Design, build, and operate reliable cloud platforms, bringing depth in one or more areas such as compute, networking, storage, stateful systems, or infrastructure control planes.
  • Improve the scalability, capacity management, isolation, recovery, and cost efficiency of critical production infrastructure.
  • Build standardized infrastructure-as-code workflows and reusable automation that support self-service provisioning, testing, progressive rollout, reconciliation, rollback, and drift prevention. 
  • Identify shared failure modes and build safeguards that prevent localized failures from escalating into broad customer impact.
  • Contribute to multi-account, multi-region, and isolated AWS architectures, including regulated environments such as GovCloud.
  • Participate in operational ownership and incident response, using incidents and near misses to drive durable architectural improvements.
  • Mentor engineers, raise the quality of infrastructure design and operational judgment, and establish patterns that can be adopted across the organization.
  • Clearly communicate architecture, trade-offs, risks, and migration plans to technical and organizational stakeholders.
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara's cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices.

Minimum requirements for this role.

  • 6+ years of experience designing and building software, infrastructure, or distributed systems, including operating critical systems in production.
  • Deep expertise in at least one of the following: compute and workload orchestration, networking, storage and stateful systems, or cloud infrastructure control planes.
  • Strong software-engineering fundamentals in Go, Python, Java, or a similar language.
  • Hands-on experience designing and operating infrastructure on a major public cloud platform; AWS experience is preferred.
  • Experience using infrastructure as code, such as Terraform, to safely manage production infrastructure.
  • Strong understanding of capacity management, failure domains, observability, rollout safety, and production recovery.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead complex technical initiatives across teams and through ambiguous problem spaces.
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience

An ideal candidate also has:

  • Designing and operating large-scale compute or container platforms such as ECS, EKS, Kubernetes, or similar orchestration systems.
  • Designing and operating stateful distributed systems such as Kafka, OpenSearch, managed databases, caching, or large-scale storage platforms.
  • Building internal infrastructure platforms, control planes, or self-service developer experiences adopted across multiple teams.
  • Designing multi-account or multi-region cloud architectures with strong workload isolation and disaster recovery.
  • Leading major infrastructure migrations while maintaining availability and controlling operational risk.
  • Delivering measurable improvements in infrastructure capacity, cost efficiency, or developer self-service.

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you're ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working 

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual's ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations 

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara's Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

  • Expérience client : Vous avez une première expérience dans la vente, la gestion de comptes, ou dans une fonction impliquant un contact régulier avec des clients, de préférence dans le SaaS B2B.

  • Expertise juridique : Une formation/expérience juridique confirmée est un plus
  • Résilience et culture du résultat : Vous êtes persévérant(e) et animé(e) par l’atteinte d’objectifs commerciaux et la satisfaction client.

title: Head of GTM Systems & AI
description: Introduction to the Team & Role   What if your team was the one that got to build the future of how a company runs — and tried it on itself first?   GTM Systems owns the tech stack behind 360Learning's commercial engine — Salesforce, Marketo, data enrichment and AI tooling across sales, marketing, customer success and services. Our mission is to be a force multiplier for the business: making go-to-market faster, smarter and more effective.   We already have a high-performing team, mature systems, extensive documentation, and an ambitious AI vision. Now we need someone to build on that foundation and take it to the next level.   You'll work closely with GTM leaders, operators, data teams and engineering to turn ambiguous business problems into reliable, scalable products. You'll partner with each team to define the target state — where AI can take work off their plate, and where the human touch matters — then build the systems and agents that get them there.   This is a high-impact role for someone who loves working at the intersection of product, systems, AI and go-to-market strategy.   Key Responsibility Areas Own the internal AI operating model for GTM — the library of skills, agent evals, cost, adoption and ROI — in partnership with Data and Enablement. Drive adoption and change management for new GTM capabilities across distributed teams. Within 6 months, you will: Have co-written the next quarter's objectives with the performance and enablement teams, each one stating the business problem, the current state, the expected impact and the plan. Have built with modern AI tooling: agents, plugins or skills on top of LLMs, connectors to business systems, and evals that tell you whether an agent is good. You define KPIs, run experiments, and use data to prioritize where to invest and to measure real impact on pipeline, conversion, efficiency and revenue. You drive  strategic alignment and executive communication — conclusion first, tradeoffs named, complex topics made simple — and you drive change through to adoption. raw.description:
Introduction to the Team & Role

 
What if your team was the one that got to build the future of how a company runs — and tried it on itself first?
 
GTM Systems owns the tech stack behind 360Learning's commercial engine — Salesforce, Marketo, data enrichment and AI tooling across sales, marketing, customer success and services. Our mission is to be a force multiplier for the business: making go-to-market faster, smarter and more effective.
 
We already have a high-performing team, mature systems, extensive documentation, and an ambitious AI vision. Now we need someone to build on that foundation and take it to the next level.
 
You'll work closely with GTM leaders, operators, data teams and engineering to turn ambiguous business problems into reliable, scalable products. You'll partner with each team to define the target state — where AI can take work off their plate, and where the human touch matters — then build the systems and agents that get them there.
 
This is a high-impact role for someone who loves working at the intersection of product, systems, AI and go-to-market strategy.
 

Key Responsibility Areas

  • Own the internal AI operating model for GTM — the library of skills, agent evals, cost, adoption and ROI — in partnership with Data and Enablement.
  • Keep the team a step ahead as customer zero for AI, turning what works into patterns other functions adopt.

title: Design System Manager - Consultant.e
description: Mindset Chez Thiga, nous considérons qu’un Design System n’est pas seulement un ensemble de composants ou de règles : c’est un produit à part entière . Un produit pensé pour évoluer, répondre aux besoins des équipes, et accompagner la croissance de l’entreprise. Créer et faire vivre un Design System demande une vision , une stratégie claire , et une gouvernance solide . Il faut piloter son adoption, anticiper ses usages à grande échelle, et s’assurer qu’il réponde aux enjeux à la fois du Design et de la Tech. C’est un levier puissant pour faire monter en maturité les organisations, structurer la collaboration entre les équipes, et diffuser une culture produit forte. Aujourd'hui, un Design System bien structuré est aussi la condition sine qua non pour tirer pleinement parti de l'IA dans les workflows design et prototypage. Tokens cohérents, composants documentés, nomenclature rigoureuse autant de fondations qui permettent d'exploiter les outils d'IA générative (Figma Make, Lovable, v0...) de manière fiable et scalable. Le.la Design System Manager de demain est celui.celle qui anticipe ces usages et structure son système en conséquence. Les Design System Managers que nous recherchons pensent leur système comme un produit vivant, automatisé au maximum, et conçu pour connecter Design et Ingénierie dans un workflow sans friction . How we work together 🤝 Mettre en place des rituels d'adoption et d'amélioration continue :offices hours, sessions de feedback, contribution guidelines pour que le DS soit co-construit et adopté par toutes les équipes. Aligner Design et Engineering en continu : organiser des syncs réguliers avec les équipes dev pour garantir la cohérence entre les composants Figma et leur implémentation code. Le DS ne vit pas dans Figma seul; il vit dans la production. Piloter l'alignement stratégique multi-équipes : s'assurer que Produit, Tech, Design et business partagent la même vision et roadmap du DS, intégrée au même niveau que les autres produits. Répondre aux besoins des utilisateurs et contributeurs : centraliser les demandes, prioriser les évolutions, et faciliter la contribution fluide de designers, développeurs et PMs. Fédérer autour d'une culture DS partagée : faire du DS un produit vivant et co-créé, en favorisant des échanges transparents et en embarquant les équipes dans sa vision long terme How we get work done 🚀 Définir et piloter la roadmap du DS : feuille de route alignée sur les priorités produit et business, avec des objectifs mesurables à court et long terme. Automatiser les workflows du DS au maximum : pipelines de tokens, synchronisation design to code en temps réel, scripts de génération de documentation, réduire au minimum les tâches manuelles et les risques de désynchronisation. Structurer le DS pour l'IA et le prototypage rapide : concevoir une architecture de composants et de tokens qui rende le DS exploitable par les outils d'IA générative (Figma Make, Cursor, v0, Lovable...). Cela implique : nomenclature stricte,variantes bien définies, props documentées, et une logique de composants qui s'aligne avec les patterns du code. Garantir la cohérence design-code : mettre en place des outils de vérification automatique pour s'assurer que ce qui est designé est bien ce qui est développé sans avoir à le vérifier manuellement. Promouvoir les bonnes pratiques à grande échelle : formations, ateliers, documentation vivante pour que le DS soit utilisé de manière fluide et scalable par toutes les équipes. Mesurer l'impact et itérer : KPIs d'adoption, indicateurs de qualité, retours qualitatifs pour évaluer l'impact du DS et ajuster les priorités How our work creates impact 🎯   Accélérer le delivery produit : composants prêts à l'emploi, pipelines automatisés et prompts IA calibrés sur le DS. Les équipes conçoivent et développent plus vite, avec moins de friction Rendre le prototypage IA fiable et scalable : un DS bien structuré devient le langage commun entre les designers et les outils d'IA les prototypes générés sont cohérents avec la prod, pas jetables Garantir la qualité et la cohérence design à l'échelle : expérience utilisateur homogène, identité de marque renforcée, dette design et technique réduite Réduire la dette et simplifier la maintenance : moins de doublons, moins de variantes inutiles, un code plus accessible et plus performant Faire monter l'organisation en maturité design : culture de collaboration Design × Tech structurée, vision stratégique du design renforcée, documentation vivante comme levier de montée en compétence Compétences 💼 Vision système et stratégie DS : u sais définir une stratégie de DS et la décliner en roadmap concrète, en alignement avec les priorités produit, tech et business. Tu fais preuve de leadership pour porter cette vision et embarquer les équipes. Alignement Design-Engineering :  tu as une solide compréhension des enjeux front-end (tokens, design-to-code, systèmes de composants) et tu dialogues en égal avec les développeurs pas seulement pour les convaincre, mais pour co-construire les bonnes solutions. Automatisation et tooling DS : tu maîtrises les pipelines de tokens, les outils de documentation (Storybook, Zeroheight) et tu as une appétence pour l'automatisation des workflows DS. IA et prototypage avancé : tu comprends comment un DS structuré permet de tirer parti des outils d'IA générative pour le design et le prototypage. Tu anticipes ces usages dans les décisions d'architecture du DS. Gestion de produit interne : tu pilotes le DS comme un vrai produit : besoins utilisateurs, priorisation, KPIs, itération continue. Communication et influence : tu sais formuler des livrables synthétiques et stratégiques (vision, roadmap, modèles de gouvernance, dashboards) pour aligner des interlocuteurs variés équipes opérationnelles, direction produit, stakeholders. Outils : figma (Variables, Dev Mode, Make), Storybook, Zeroheight, Notion, Jira/Linear, Style Dictionary, et une bonne aisance avec les environnements no-code/low-code et outils IA de prototypage. Anglais courant : à l'écrit comme à l'oral Qualités 🌟   Tu penses en systèmes : tu comprends les logiques systémiques et sais structurer un DS cohérent, extensible, et exploitable par l'IA Tu automatises par réflexe : tu cherches à réduire les tâches manuelles et à construire des workflows robustes qui s'auto-maintiennent. Tu es le pont entre Design et Tech : tu parles les deux langages et tu sais créer les conditions d'un alignement durable entre les équipes. Tu portes une vision : tu es capable de convaincre, d'aligner et d'embarquer des designers comme des ingénieurs, des opérationnels comme des dirigeants. Tu pilotes ton DS comme un produit : besoins utilisateurs internes, KPIs, roadmap priorisée tu traites le DS avec la même rigueur qu'un produit client. Tu restes curieux·se et en veille : sur les outils, les pratiques et l'évolution rapide des Design Systems et des usages IA dans le design Expérience 📇 Tu as au moins 5 ans d'expérience en Product Design, Design System Management ou un rôle similaire, avec une trajectoire confirmée ou senior Tu as déjà créé ou fortement structuré un Design System de zéro ou à grande échelle , pas seulement contribué à l'un Tu as mis en place des pipelines de tokens, des processus d'automatisation et des intégrations design to code Tu as expérimenté avec des outils d'IA générative , dans un contexte design ou DS (Figma Make, Cursor, v0, Lovable, ou équivalent) Tu as travaillé aussi bien en scale-up qu'en grand groupe, ce qui te donne une bonne lecture des modèles d'organisation et des leviers pour faire évoluer la maturité design. Tu as travaillé en méthodologie agile et sais comment intégrer le DS dans ces processus de delivery. Ce que nous offrons 🎊 Un on-boarding pour rencontrer tes collègues  De l’apprentissage avec minimum 5 jours de formations à l’année, des sessions de partage hebdomadaires et du contenu pour te faire monter en compétences Du mentoring sur ta mission par un pair plus confirmé  Du confort avec deux jours de télétravail par semaine (selon ton client) complétés par un accès à un catalogue de matériels, ainsi qu’un Macbook Air ou un PC selon ta préférence. Du fun avec des Thigapéros, des Team building et un séminaire (en prêtant attention à notre empreinte carbone). Et pleins d’autres avantages comme une carte Swile, le remboursement de ton abonnement de transport à 50%/forfait mobilité durable, etc. Les étapes du process 🎢 Un pré-entretien téléphonique avec une membre de l’équipe Recrutement L'évaluation de ton portfolio par nos Designers Une rencontre avec un.e Principal, un.e Manager de la Tribe ou un Partner pour s’assurer que nous partageons les mêmes valeurs et ambitions Un entretien plus opérationnel avec un ou deux membres senior de notre équipe pour évaluer ta compréhension du rôle de Design System Manager, ta capacité à résoudre des problèmes liés au Design System, tes convictions, tes attentes, etc. Une dernière rencontre pour finaliser le process, s’accorder sur une ambition commune, des objectifs et un périmètre d’intervention 🤝 Thiga accueille toutes les personnes compétentes et passionnées et s'engage en faveur de la diversité culturelle, l'égalité de genre et l'emploi des travailleurs handicapés — au contraire nous considérons la diversité comme une grande richesse ! title: Account Manager EMEA
description: <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>Horizon Trading Solutions is an independent global technology company focused on electronic trading, supporting agency and principal business activities across equities and derivatives.</p> <p>For over 20 years, we have equipped leading capital market participants with algorithmic trading technology and direct connectivity to more than 80 exchanges worldwide.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>We are currently looking for an Account Manager EMEA to strengthen to drive sustainable revenue growth and increase the value of Horizon’s existing client accounts by developing structured account plans, identifying upsell and cross-sell opportunities, securing renewals and strengthening relationships with key decision-makers. The Account Manager acts as the commercial owner of each account and coordinates internal teams to turn client knowledge into profitable growth.</p> <h1>Key Responsibilities</h1> <h2>1. Grow the Existing Client Portfolio</h2> <ul> <li>Develop and manage an account plan for each priority account, covering growth potential, stakeholder mapping, key challenges, competition, opportunities and actions.</li> <li>Identify, qualify and convert upsell, cross-sell, geographic expansion and functional expansion opportunities.</li> <li>Build a reliable, documented expansion pipeline and keep it regularly updated in the CRM.</li> <li>Prepare business cases and commercial proposals, and lead negotiations and contracting through to closing.</li> </ul> <h2>2. Secure Retention and Renewals</h2> <ul> <li>Anticipate renewals and churn risks, with a retention plan shared with the relevant teams.</li> <li>Monitor product usage, client satisfaction, value delivered and commercial pain points across the portfolio.</li> <li>Lead account reviews and executive business reviews, providing actionable recommendations.</li> </ul> <h2>3. Build Executive Relationships</h2> <ul> <li>Build lasting relationships with sponsors and decision-makers across business, IT, trading, operations and procurement.</li> <li>Understand each client’s strategy, organisation and priorities in order to develop new use cases.</li> <li>Represent the voice of the client internally while protecting Horizon’s commercial interests.</li> </ul> <h2>4. Coordinate Internal Execution</h2> <ul> <li>Coordinate Client Services, Customer Delivery, Product, PreSales, Legal and Finance around the account objectives.</li> <li>Ensure clear handovers and follow through on commitments made to clients.</li> <li>Share market signals, client needs and competitive insights that can inform the product roadmap.</li> </ul> <h2>5. Manage Performance</h2> <ul> <li>Track growth, retention, pipeline, forecast, stakeholder coverage and margin indicators.</li> <li>Produce evidence-based forecasts, explain variances and recommend corrective actions.</li> <li>Contribute to commercial discipline, sales methodologies and the team’s continuous improvement.</li> </ul> <h1>Expected Outcomes Within 12 Months</h1> <ul> <li>100% of priority accounts have an approved account plan that is updated quarterly.</li> <li>Achievement of the annual recurring revenue and/or revenue expansion target across the assigned portfolio (quantified target to be defined).</li> <li>A qualified expansion pipeline maintained at a level consistent with the annual objective (recommended benchmark: at least 3x the target).</li> <li>Renewal rate and net revenue retention in line with agreed objectives, with no strategic renewal identified too late.</li> <li>Multi-threaded mapping of decision-makers and influencers across all strategic accounts.</li> <li>Reliable monthly forecast, up-to-date CRM data, and clearly documented risks and opportunities.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><span style="font-size: 24pt;"><strong>What we are looking for</strong></span></p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <ul> <li>At least five years of experience in account management, sales or complex B2B business development.</li> <li>Experience in finance or capital markets is mandatory: investment banking, brokerage, asset management, fintech, financial software or a comparable environment.</li> <li>Demonstrable results in growing existing accounts, complex negotiations and managing long sales cycles.</li> <li>Ability to engage effectively with both business and technical stakeholders, including at executive level.</li> <li>Understanding of SaaS/licensing models, recurring revenue, renewals and account profitability.</li> <li>Exposure to trading technology, software platforms, APIs/connectivity or IT projects would be a strong advantage.</li> <li>Professional fluency in French and English is essential; another European language would be an advantage.</li> </ul> <h1>Skills and Behaviours</h1> <ul> <li>Growth mindset and results orientation</li> <li>Knowledge of financial markets and understanding of client challenges</li> <li>Account planning and prioritisation skills</li> <li>Influencing, active listening and relationship-building skills</li> <li>Commercial negotiation and value-based selling</li> <li>Cross-functional collaboration and strong execution</li> <li>CRM discipline, forecasting and data-driven management</li> <li>Technological curiosity, autonomy and an entrepreneurial mindset</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p></p> <p><em>Horizon is an equal opportunity employer. We promote diversity, multiculturalism, and inclusion.</em></p> <p></p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

technologiques stratégiques : co-construction des offres, des plans d’affaires et de la démarche de co-selling autour de nos <em>capabilities </em>auprès de clients et prospects,</li> <li>Orchestrateur de l’écosystème en interne : enablement des équipes, montée en compétence et certifications sur les plateformes partenaires, pour activer la bonne expertise au sein de WPP Enterprise Solutions et du réseau WPP</li> </ul> <p>Cette hybridation est la clé du succès : être à la fois moteur du business généré via l’écosystème partenaires et garant de la capacité des équipes à délivrer avec ces technologies.</p> <p><em>Dimension Business :</em></p> <ul> <li>Définit et déploie la stratégie de go-to-market et de marketing partenaires de WPP Enterprise Solutions avec ses partenaires technologiques stratégiques, afin de maximiser la valeur, la différenciation et le pipeline générés par l’écosystème,</li> <li>Construit et anime les plans d’affaires conjoints (joint business plans) avec chaque partenaire clé (Adobe, AWS, Braze, Google, Microsoft, Salesforce, Shopify…), en pilotant objectifs, jalons et indicateurs de performance partagés,</li> <li>Orchestre le co-selling et le co-marketing : aligne partenaires, équipes commerciales et Business Units pour transformer les opportunités de l’écosystème en deals, du sourcing à la conversion,</li> <li>Conçoit et orchestre le plan d’événements dédiés ou co-construits avec les partenaires (webinaires, ateliers, salons, temps forts commerciaux), afin de générer visibilité, demande et pipeline,</li> <li>Met en œuvre, en continu, l’excellence de la démarche partenaires via les processus et outils internes ainsi que les portails partenaires, à des fins de visibilité, de pilotage et d’animation globale en interne,</li> produits, niveaux et programmes de partenariat, dispositifs de financement) afin d’accélérer et de fluidifier l’action commerciale,</li> <li>Incarne, diffuse et fait vivre l’excellence du modèle partenaires en interne, en particulier auprès des communautés commerciale et managériale, pour l’inspirer et développer son réflexe écosystème.</li> </ul> <p><em>Dimension Enablement &amp; Delivery :</em></p> <ul> <li>Travaille de concert avec le CTO, à qui revient la responsabilité de l’enablement, des certifications et de la montée en compétences des équipes sur les plateformes partenaires ; <p>Notre croissance reposant sur un écosystème de partenaires technologiques (Adobe, AWS, Braze, Google, Microsoft, Salesforce, Shopify…), vous maîtrisez les mécaniques de co-selling, de co-marketing logique ou les bonnes pratiques.</p> <p>Votre capacité à nouer des relations de grande qualité, tant avec les équipes partenaires (alliance managers, channel, avant-vente) qu’avec les décideurs internes (Directions commerciales, Business Units, Marketing), fait de vous un orchestrateur d’écosystème performant, du sourcing d’opportunités à la conclusion de deals conjoints équilibrant les intérêts du partenaire, du client et de WPP Enterprise Solutions.</p> <p>Les enjeux des plateformes technologiques et de l’écosystème IA / data / commerce vous passionnent, et vous savez vous appuyer sur vos expériences pour bâtir un discours solide en interne comme auprès des partenaires.</p> <p>Votre rigueur et votre curiosité font de vous un acteur à la fois à l’aise dans la logique de raw.description:
Streaming TV is no longer just a brand awareness channel. It’s becoming a core part of the performance marketing mix, alongside search and social. Vibe.co is building the platform that makes TV work like the rest of the acquisition stack: targeted, measurable, and optimized for results.

Vibe.co is an Audience First Streaming TV Advertising platform that gives marketers the tools to reach the right audiences, optimize campaigns in real time, and understand what’s actually driving business outcomes. With hyper-targeted segmentation, AI-powered recommendations, real-time optimization, and incrementality measurement, Vibe brings the precision and accountability of digital advertising to the biggest screen in the house.

Today, more than 12,000 brands use Vibe.co to reach 120 million+ households. And in August 2026, Vibe.co became a Walmart company, opening up a new chapter for the business and the industry. With Walmart’s first-party data and purchase signals now part of the Vibe platform, advertisers can connect TV advertising to real-world transactions and measure the impact of CTV with a level of precision previously associated with platforms like Google and Meta.

This is a unique moment to join Vibe. With Walmart’s scale, data, and reach behind us, we’re building the next generation of TV advertising and creating a more measurable, performance-driven future for the channel.

About the Role

You'll be Vibe's founding security hire. Security has been part of how we build since day one and we're already SOC 2 Type 2 compliant, but nobody has owned it full-time. Ad spend and headcount have both roughly doubled every year since 2022, enterprise partnerships keep expanding, and the more visible Vibe becomes, the more scrutiny comes with it. Now it needs an owner.

You'll define the risk model, set the roadmap, decide what we harden and what we accept, and turn policies into running procedures in code on the paths engineers and AI already use. That work happens in a cloud native ecosystem across AWS and GCP, with most of our services running on Kubernetes, everything as code and a GitOps deployment model.

Reporting to our, Head of Infrastructure, and joining a lean six-person Infrastructure and IT team. You won't do it alone, but you'll be the main contributor, and the person every team turns to on security. Since we joined forces with Walmart, you'll also coordinate directly with their cloud security teams.

What You'll Do

Risk & Governance

  • Map Vibe's risk model across every major system.

  • Set the security roadmap with clear priorities.

Security Engineering

  • Pave the road with guardrails and secure defaults enforced across the engineering tool set.

  • Ship the golden paths so the safe way is the easy one.

  • Harden security across our cloud native ecosystem (AWS and GCP) and third-party providers.

  • Own access management from onboarding to offboarding, and get it to the point where it runs without you.

Detection & Response

  • Prioritize vulnerability findings by real exposure, assign them to the team that owns the code, and follow remediation through to closure.

  • Own security incident response from detection through resolution.

  • Turn manual processes into pipelines that run on their own.

  • Launch and run Vibe's private bug bounty program.

Trust & Compliance

  • Own SOC 2 compliance end to end and maintain current certification.

  • Drive Vibe's future compliance initiatives and requirements.

  • Define Vibe's security posture and make it self-serve so enterprise deals clear security without routing through you.

Security Culture

  • Set clear, practical rules for safe AI use, built into the tools themselves, covering both the AI we ship in our products and the AI our teams work with every day.

  • Run security awareness training and measure behavior changes so the whole company raises its bar.

What You Need

  • Built a security function as a company's first security hire.

  • Write code comfortably and bring deep cloud-native security experience.

  • Managed a compliance framework at scale, such as SOC 2, ISO 27001 or HIPAA.

  • Managed AI security risk hands on, both in what a company ships with AI and in how its employees use it day to day.

Nice to Haves

  • Ran a private bug bounty program.

  • Ad tech security background, including exposure to US privacy law (CCPA/CPRA, VPPA) in a data-heavy environment.

  • Navigated security through a company acquisition.

Our Values

At Vibe, we run on three values: Impact, Ambition, and Urgency. We tie every goal to a real business outcome, think 10x rather than settling for good enough, and move daily rather than waiting for perfect conditions.

You'll thrive here if you own outcomes without needing direction, default to action, and hold yourself to results, not effort.

This is a high-performance environment with high-performance rewards: you'll work alongside people who push you, with real ownership over hard problems in a market that's moving fast.

If that sounds like the best version of your career, we want to meet you.

What We Offer

The pay range for this role is €127,000-€171,000. We will support relocation to Paris for great candidates.

At Vibe, we want you to build something, own something, and grow fast. Here's how we back that up:

  • Variable pay — Based on real Vibe business goals.

  • Hybrid flexibility — We're in the Heart of Paris and our team is in 3x a week!

  • Health insurance — Full coverage via Alan.

  • Meal vouchers — Via Swile.

  • Annual offsite — The whole team, once a year, somewhere worth the trip.

  • Tech Syncs — Engineering and Product meet in person at least quarterly, worldwide.

Our Interview Process

We respect your time. Here's exactly what to expect, no surprises, no ghosting.

  1. Recruiter Screen — 30 minutes. We’ll share more context on the role and team, and learn more about your background and what you’re looking for.

  2. Hiring Manager Interview — 45 minutes. Meet with the person you’d work with directly and dive deeper into your experience, technical background, and approach to the role.

  3. Technical Assessment — 90 minutes. A deeper technical conversation covering core engineering skills, problem-solving, and a technical use case relevant to the role.

  4. Bar Raiser Interview — 30 minutes. Meet with a senior leader at Vibe for a final conversation and an opportunity to ask any remaining questions.

  5. Offer — We move quickly once we’ve made a decision. We don’t let good decisions sit.

Equal Opportunity

Vibe is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate all applicants without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

We believe the best ideas come from teams with different backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences. If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or interview process, please let us know.
