We sell a mix of insurance products to small businesses (SME's) in the Netherlands, Germany and France, and we are in the process of scaling into more markets. 

Insurance infrastructure is brutal to get right. Every carrier has its own spec, every product its own underwriting rules, every country its own regulatory requirements. Most insurers throw people and process at that complexity - one-off integrations, workarounds on workarounds. We're building it differently: our insurance platform is where we consolidate that complexity, so that launching a new product or market becomes a configuration exercise rather than a rebuild.

Insify is a high-growth scale-up backed by more than €40M from investors like Accel, Munich Re Ventures, and Formula 1 champion Nico Rosberg. In five years we've expanded from the Netherlands into France and Germany. Our mission: become the European leader in AI-powered SME insurance.


About the role

You would join the Shop team, responsible for everything that happens after a small business buys a policy from us. You would help shape how the platform handles the next product and the next country, on a system already carrying live policies and real customers.

The team owns end-to-end policy lifecycle management (mid-term adjustments, automated renewals, cancellations, and payment flows) alongside the backoffice tooling that gives our operations and support teams full visibility and control. We work closely with the Claims Team, and with the Activation Teams that turn a lead into a paying customer. Product and engineering together are 30+ people.

Every country has its own regulatory quirks, and every insurance product has unique data structures, lifecycle rules, and money flows.

As we expand across Europe, our goal isn't to write custom glue code for every new launch. It's to design elegant, reusable platform abstractions. We're building a system where introducing a new country or product feels like snapping modular building blocks together.

You're joining at an exciting inflection point: we have real traction, proven scale, and you get to directly build the foundational platform that powers our next wave of European growth.


What you'll be doing
  • Owning end-to-end the discovery and delivery of crucial platform features that enable our ability to scale as an insurance business
  • Continuously and relentlessly seeking opportunities to turn new product demands into platform capabilities and features that scale across countries and insurance product lines
  • Challenging our ideas and bringing your own. We encourage each other to act this way, so you can expect the same from others

    • What you'll need
  • 3+ years building complex web applications and services, with real production ownership
  • Ownership & impact instinct - when needed you go beyond your direct stack to get to results, be that data / backend / frontend
  • You get real leverage out of AI in your daily work, and you can say where it helped, and where it hurt
  • Strong fundamentals in domain-driven design & service oriented architecture
    • Not all of the above are hard requirements. If you're strong on most of these and eager to grow into the rest, we'd still love to hear from you.

    Nice to have
  • Experience building B2B products, especially in insurance & fintech
  • Experience working on a product distributed across different country markets
  • Strong observability instincts. You know where things will break, and can help others learn that too

    • Our stack

    TypeScript across the board, running on AWS (IaaC), in a single monorepo. If you have not worked with all of it, that is fine. We care more about how you reason about systems than about which tools you have used before.


    We offer
  • Competitive compensation that reflects responsibility and impact. For this role the range is €65,000 to €85,000.
  • Trust and autonomy. You'll have real ownership, room to make decisions, and space to shape your role as Insify evolves.
  • Hybrid working. 3 days in the office, 2 from home, up to 4 weeks a year working from abroad, and 25 holiday days.
  • Pension. We contribute 6% for you.
  • Alleo budget. €50 net a month to spend on whatever you want, from the gym to takeaway. It rolls over if you don't use it.
  • Learning and coaching. Internal leadership programs, and coaching to go with them.
  • A central Amsterdam office. Shared lunches, dogs, whiteboards, and Friday drinks.
  • Hardware & setup. A high-spec MacBook Pro, high-res monitors at the office, and comfortable ergonomic seating.

title: Research Staff, Voice AI Foundations - Remote
description: Company Overview Deepgram is the leading platform underpinning the emerging trillion-dollar Voice AI economy, providing real-time APIs for speech-to-text (STT), text-to-speech (TTS), and building production-grade voice agents at scale. More than 200,000 developers and 1,300+ organizations build voice offerings that are ‘Powered by Deepgram’, including Twilio, Cloudflare, Sierra, Decagon, Vapi, Daily, Cresta, Granola, and Jack in the Box. Deepgram’s voice-native foundation models are accessed through cloud APIs or as self-hosted and on-premises software, with unmatched accuracy, low latency, and cost efficiency. Backed by a recent Series C led by leading global investors and strategic partners, Deepgram has processed over 50,000 years of audio and transcribed more than 1 trillion words. There is no organization in the world that understands voice better than Deepgram. Company Operating Rhythm At Deepgram, we expect an AI-first mindset—AI use and comfort aren’t optional, they’re core to how we operate, innovate, and measure performance. Every team member who works at Deepgram is expected to actively use and experiment with advanced AI tools, and even build your own into your everyday work. We measure how effectively AI is applied to deliver results, and consistent, creative use of the latest AI capabilities is key to success here. Candidates should be comfortable adopting new models and modes quickly, integrating AI into their workflows, and continuously pushing the boundaries of what these technologies can do. Additionally, we move at the pace of AI. Change is rapid, and you can expect your day-to-day work to evolve just as quickly. This may not be the right role if you’re not excited to experiment, adapt, think on your feet, and learn constantly, or if you’re seeking something highly prescriptive with a traditional 9-to-5. The Opportunity Voice is the most natural modality for human interaction with machines. However, current sequence modeling paradigms based on jointly scaling model and data cannot deliver voice AI capable of universal human interaction. The challenges are rooted in fundamental data problems posed by audio: real-world audio data is scarce and enormously diverse, spanning a vast space of voices, speaking styles, and acoustic conditions. Even if billions of hours of audio were accessible, its inherent high dimensionality creates computational and storage costs that make training and deployment prohibitively expensive at world scale. We believe that entirely new paradigms for audio AI are needed to overcome these challenges and make voice interaction accessible to everyone. The Role As a Member of the Research Staff, you will pioneer the development of Latent Space Models (LSMs), a new approach that aims to solve the fundamental data, scale, and cost challenges associated with building robust, contextualized voice AI. Your research will focus on solving one or more of the following problems: Build next-generation neural audio codecs that achieve extreme, low bit-rate compression and high fidelity reconstruction across a world-scale corpus of general audio. Pioneer steerable generative models that can synthesize the full diversity of human speech from the codec latent representation, from casual conversation to highly emotional expression to complex multi-speaker scenarios with environmental noise and overlapping speech. Develop embedding systems that cleanly factorize the codec latent space into interpretable dimensions of speaker, content, style, environment, and channel effects -- enabling precise control over each aspect and the ability to massively amplify an existing seed dataset through “latent recombination”. Leverage latent recombination to generate synthetic audio data at previously impossible scales, unlocking joint model and data scaling paradigms for audio. Endeavor to train multimodal speech-to-speech systems that can 1) understand any human irrespective of their demographics, state, or environment and 2) produce empathic, human-like responses that achieve conversational or task-oriented objectives. Design model architectures, training schemes, and inference algorithms that are adapted for hardware at the bare metal enabling cost efficient training on billion-hour datasets and powering real-time inference for hundreds of millions of concurrent conversations. The Challenge We are seeking researchers who: See "unsolved" problems as opportunities to pioneer entirely new approaches Can identify the one critical experiment that will validate or kill an idea in days, not months Have the vision to scale successful proofs-of-concept 100x Are obsessed with using AI to automate and amplify your own impact If you find yourself energized rather than daunted by these expectations—if you're already thinking about five ideas to try while reading this—you might be the researcher we need. This role demands obsession with the problems, creativity in approach, and relentless drive toward elegant, scalable solutions. The technical challenges are immense, but the potential impact is transformative. It's Important to Us That You Have Strong mathematical foundation in statistical learning theory, particularly in areas relevant to self-supervised and multimodal learning Deep expertise in foundation model architectures, with an understanding of how to scale training across multiple modalities Proven ability to bridge theory and practice—someone who can both derive novel mathematical formulations and implement them efficiently Demonstrated ability to build data pipelines that can process and curate massive datasets while maintaining quality and diversity Track record of designing controlled experiments that isolate the impact of architectural innovations and validate theoretical insights Experience optimizing models for real-world deployment, including knowledge of hardware constraints and efficiency techniques History of open-source contributions or research publications that have advanced the state of the art in speech/language AI Ideal Researcher Profile An ideal researcher, as evidenced by the recurring themes across these foundational papers, excels in five key areas: (1) Statistical & Mathematical Foundations, (2) Algorithmic Innovation & Implementation, (3) Data-Driven & Scalable Systems, (4) Hardware & Systems Understanding, and (5) Rigorous Experimental Design. Below is a synthesis of how each paper highlights these qualities, with references illustrating why they matter for building robust, impactful deep learning models. 1. Statistical & Mathematical Foundations Mastery of Core Concepts Many papers, like Scaling Laws for Neural Language Models and Neural Discrete Representation Learning (VQ-VAE), reflect the importance of power-law analyses, derivation of novel losses, or adaptation of fundamental equations (e.g., in VQ-VAE's commitment loss or rectified flows in Scaling Rectified Flow Transformers). Such mathematical grounding clarifies why models converge or suffer collapse. Combining Existing Theories in Novel Ways Papers such as Moshi (combining text modeling, audio codecs, and hierarchical generative modeling) and Finite Scalar Quantization (FSQ's adaptation of classic scalar quantization to replace vector-quantized representations) show how reusing but reimagining known techniques can yield breakthroughs. Many references (e.g., the structured state-space duality in Transformers are SSMs) underscore how unifying previously separate research lines can reveal powerful algorithmic or theoretical insights. Logical Reasoning and Assumption Testing Across all papers—particularly in the problem statements of Whisper or Rectified Flow Transformers—the authors present assumptions (e.g., "scaling data leads to zero-shot robustness" or "straight-line noise injection improves sample efficiency") and systematically verify them with thorough empirical results. An ideal researcher similarly grounds new ideas in well-formed, testable hypotheses. 2. Algorithmic Innovation & Implementation Creative Solutions to Known Bottlenecks Each paper puts forth a unique algorithmic contribution—Rectified Flow Transformers redefines standard diffusion paths, FSQ proposes simpler scalar quantizations contrasted with VQ, phi-3 mini relies on curated data and blocksparse attention, and Mamba-2 merges SSM speed with attention concepts. Turning Theory into Practice Whether it's the direct preference optimization (DPO) for alignment in phi-3 or the residual vector quantization in SoundStream, these works show that bridging design insights with implementable prototypes is essential. Clear Impact Through Prototypes & Open-Source Many references (Whisper, neural discrete representation learning, Mamba-2) highlight releasing code or pretrained models, enabling the broader community to replicate and build upon new methods. This premise of collaboration fosters faster progress. 3. Data-Driven & Scalable Systems Emphasis on Large-Scale Data and Efficient Pipelines Papers such as Robust Speech Recognition via Large-Scale Weak Supervision (Whisper) and BASE TTS demonstrate that collecting and processing hundreds of thousands of hours of real-world audio can unlock new capabilities in zero-shot or low-resource domains. Meanwhile, phi-3 Technical Report shows that filtering and curating data at scale (e.g., "data optimal regime") can yield high performance even in smaller models. Strategic Use of Data for Staged Training A recurring strategy is to vary sources of data or the order of tasks. Whisper trains on multilingual tasks, BASE TTS uses subsets/stages for pretraining on speech tokens, and phi-3 deploys multiple training phases (web data, then synthetic data). This systematic approach to data underscores how an ideal researcher designs training curricula and data filtering protocols for maximum performance. 4. Hardware & Systems Understanding Efficient Implementations at Scale Many works illustrate how researchers tune architectures for modern accelerators: the In-Datacenter TPU paper exemplifies domain-specific hardware design for dense matrix multiplications, while phi-3 leverages blocksparse attention and custom Triton kernels to run advanced LLMs on resource-limited devices. Real-Time & On-Device Constraints SoundStream shows how to compress audio in real time on a smartphone CPU, demonstrating that knowledge of hardware constraints (latency, limited memory) drives design choices. Similarly, Moshi's low-latency streaming TTS and phi-3-mini's phone-based inference highlight that an ideal researcher must adapt algorithms to resource limits while maintaining robustness. Architectural & Optimization Details Papers like Mamba-2 in Transformers are SSMs and the In-Datacenter TPU work show how exploiting specialized matrix decomposition, custom memory hierarchies, or quantization approaches can lead to breakthroughs in speed or energy efficiency. 5. Rigorous Experimental Design Controlled Comparisons & Ablations Nearly all papers—Whisper, FSQ, Mamba-2, BASE TTS—use systematic ablations to isolate the impact of individual components (e.g., ablation on vector-quantization vs. scalar quantization in FSQ, or size of codebooks in VQ-VAEs). This approach reveals which design decisions truly matter. Multifold Evaluation Metrics From MUSHRA listening tests (SoundStream, BASE TTS) to FID in image synthesis (Scaling Rectified Flow Transformers, FSQ) to perplexity or zero-shot generalization in language (phi-3, Scaling Laws for Neural Language Models), the works demonstrate the value of comprehensive, carefully chosen metrics. Stress Tests & Edge Cases Whisper's out-of-distribution speech benchmarks, SoundStream's evaluation on speech + music, or Mamba-2's performance on multi-query associative recall demonstrate the importance of specialized challenge sets. Researchers who craft or adopt rigorous benchmarks and "red-team" their models (as in phi-3 safety alignment) are better prepared to address real-world complexities. raw.title: Research Staff, Voice AI Foundations - Remote
raw.description:
Company Overview

Deepgram is the leading platform underpinning the emerging trillion-dollar Voice AI economy, providing real-time APIs for speech-to-text (STT), text-to-speech (TTS), and building production-grade voice agents at scale. More than 200,000 developers and 1,300+ organizations build voice offerings that are ‘Powered by Deepgram’, including Twilio, Cloudflare, Sierra, Decagon, Vapi, Daily, Cresta, Granola, and Jack in the Box. Deepgram’s voice-native foundation models are accessed through cloud APIs or as self-hosted and on-premises software, with unmatched accuracy, low latency, and cost efficiency. Backed by a recent Series C led by leading global investors and strategic partners, Deepgram has processed over 50,000 years of audio and transcribed more than 1 trillion words. There is no organization in the world that understands voice better than Deepgram.

Company Operating Rhythm

At Deepgram, we expect an AI-first mindset—AI use and comfort aren’t optional, they’re core to how we operate, innovate, and measure performance.

Every team member who works at Deepgram is expected to actively use and experiment with advanced AI tools, and even build your own into your everyday work. We measure how effectively AI is applied to deliver results, and consistent, creative use of the latest AI capabilities is key to success here. Candidates should be comfortable adopting new models and modes quickly, integrating AI into their workflows, and continuously pushing the boundaries of what these technologies can do.

Additionally, we move at the pace of AI. Change is rapid, and you can expect your day-to-day work to evolve just as quickly. This may not be the right role if you’re not excited to experiment, adapt, think on your feet, and learn constantly, or if you’re seeking something highly prescriptive with a traditional 9-to-5.

The Opportunity

Voice is the most natural modality for human interaction with machines. However, current sequence modeling paradigms based on jointly scaling model and data cannot deliver voice AI capable of universal human interaction. The challenges are rooted in fundamental data problems posed by audio: real-world audio data is scarce and enormously diverse, spanning a vast space of voices, speaking styles, and acoustic conditions. Even if billions of hours of audio were accessible, its inherent high dimensionality creates computational and storage costs that make training and deployment prohibitively expensive at world scale. We believe that entirely new paradigms for audio AI are needed to overcome these challenges and make voice interaction accessible to everyone.


The Role

As a Member of the Research Staff, you will pioneer the development of Latent Space Models (LSMs), a new approach that aims to solve the fundamental data, scale, and cost challenges associated with building robust, contextualized voice AI. Your research will focus on solving one or more of the following problems:

  • Build next-generation neural audio codecs that achieve extreme, low bit-rate compression and high fidelity reconstruction across a world-scale corpus of general audio.

  • Pioneer steerable generative models that can synthesize the full diversity of human speech from the codec latent representation, from casual conversation to highly emotional expression to complex multi-speaker scenarios with environmental noise and overlapping speech.

  • Develop embedding systems that cleanly factorize the codec latent space into interpretable dimensions of speaker, content, style, environment, and channel effects -- enabling precise control over each aspect and the ability to massively amplify an existing seed dataset through “latent recombination”.

  • Leverage latent recombination to generate synthetic audio data at previously impossible scales, unlocking joint model and data scaling paradigms for audio.  Endeavor to train multimodal speech-to-speech systems that can 1) understand any human irrespective of their demographics, state, or environment and 2) produce empathic, human-like responses that achieve conversational or task-oriented objectives.   

  • Design model architectures, training schemes, and inference algorithms that are adapted for hardware at the bare metal enabling cost efficient training on billion-hour datasets and powering real-time inference for hundreds of millions of concurrent conversations.

The Challenge

We are seeking researchers who:

  • See "unsolved" problems as opportunities to pioneer entirely new approaches

  • Can identify the one critical experiment that will validate or kill an idea in days, not months

  • Have the vision to scale successful proofs-of-concept 100x

  • Are obsessed with using AI to automate and amplify your own impact

If you find yourself energized rather than daunted by these expectations—if you're already thinking about five ideas to try while reading this—you might be the researcher we need. This role demands obsession with the problems, creativity in approach, and relentless drive toward elegant, scalable solutions. The technical challenges are immense, but the potential impact is transformative.


It's Important to Us That You Have

  • Strong mathematical foundation in statistical learning theory, particularly in areas relevant to self-supervised and multimodal learning

  • Deep expertise in foundation model architectures, with an understanding of how to scale training across multiple modalities

  • Proven ability to bridge theory and practice—someone who can both derive novel mathematical formulations and implement them efficiently

  • Demonstrated ability to build data pipelines that can process and curate massive datasets while maintaining quality and diversity

  • Track record of designing controlled experiments that isolate the impact of architectural innovations and validate theoretical insights

  • Experience optimizing models for real-world deployment, including knowledge of hardware constraints and efficiency techniques

  • History of open-source contributions or research publications that have advanced the state of the art in speech/language AI


Ideal Researcher Profile

An ideal researcher, as evidenced by the recurring themes across these foundational papers, excels in five key areas: (1) Statistical & Mathematical Foundations, (2) Algorithmic Innovation & Implementation, (3) Data-Driven & Scalable Systems, (4) Hardware & Systems Understanding, and (5) Rigorous Experimental Design. Below is a synthesis of how each paper highlights these qualities, with references illustrating why they matter for building robust, impactful deep learning models.



1. Statistical & Mathematical Foundations

Mastery of Core Concepts

Many papers, like Scaling Laws for Neural Language Models and Neural Discrete Representation Learning (VQ-VAE), reflect the importance of power-law analyses, derivation of novel losses, or adaptation of fundamental equations (e.g., in VQ-VAE's commitment loss or rectified flows in Scaling Rectified Flow Transformers). Such mathematical grounding clarifies why models converge or suffer collapse.

Combining Existing Theories in Novel Ways

Papers such as Moshi (combining text modeling, audio codecs, and hierarchical generative modeling) and Finite Scalar Quantization (FSQ's adaptation of classic scalar quantization to replace vector-quantized representations) show how reusing but reimagining known techniques can yield breakthroughs. Many references (e.g., the structured state-space duality in Transformers are SSMs) underscore how unifying previously separate research lines can reveal powerful algorithmic or theoretical insights.

Logical Reasoning and Assumption Testing

Across all papers—particularly in the problem statements of Whisper or Rectified Flow Transformers—the authors present assumptions (e.g., "scaling data leads to zero-shot robustness" or "straight-line noise injection improves sample efficiency") and systematically verify them with thorough empirical results. An ideal researcher similarly grounds new ideas in well-formed, testable hypotheses.


2. Algorithmic Innovation & Implementation

Creative Solutions to Known Bottlenecks

Each paper puts forth a unique algorithmic contribution—Rectified Flow Transformers redefines standard diffusion paths, FSQ proposes simpler scalar quantizations contrasted with VQ, phi-3 mini relies on curated data and blocksparse attention, and Mamba-2 merges SSM speed with attention concepts.

Turning Theory into Practice

Whether it's the direct preference optimization (DPO) for alignment in phi-3 or the residual vector quantization in SoundStream, these works show that bridging design insights with implementable prototypes is essential.

Clear Impact Through Prototypes & Open-Source

Many references (Whisper, neural discrete representation learning, Mamba-2) highlight releasing code or pretrained models, enabling the broader community to replicate and build upon new methods. This premise of collaboration fosters faster progress.


3. Data-Driven & Scalable Systems

Emphasis on Large-Scale Data and Efficient Pipelines

Papers such as Robust Speech Recognition via Large-Scale Weak Supervision (Whisper) and BASE TTS demonstrate that collecting and processing hundreds of thousands of hours of real-world audio can unlock new capabilities in zero-shot or low-resource domains. Meanwhile, phi-3 Technical Report shows that filtering and curating data at scale (e.g., "data optimal regime") can yield high performance even in smaller models.

Strategic Use of Data for Staged Training

A recurring strategy is to vary sources of data or the order of tasks. Whisper trains on multilingual tasks, BASE TTS uses subsets/stages for pretraining on speech tokens, and phi-3 deploys multiple training phases (web data, then synthetic data). This systematic approach to data underscores how an ideal researcher designs training curricula and data filtering protocols for maximum performance.


4. Hardware & Systems Understanding

Efficient Implementations at Scale

Many works illustrate how researchers tune architectures for modern accelerators: the In-Datacenter TPU paper exemplifies domain-specific hardware design for dense matrix multiplications, while phi-3 leverages blocksparse attention and custom Triton kernels to run advanced LLMs on resource-limited devices.

Real-Time & On-Device Constraints

SoundStream shows how to compress audio in real time on a smartphone CPU, demonstrating that knowledge of hardware constraints (latency, limited memory) drives design choices. Similarly, Moshi's low-latency streaming TTS and phi-3-mini's phone-based inference highlight that an ideal researcher must adapt algorithms to resource limits while maintaining robustness.

Architectural & Optimization Details

Papers like Mamba-2 in Transformers are SSMs and the In-Datacenter TPU work show how exploiting specialized matrix decomposition, custom memory hierarchies, or quantization approaches can lead to breakthroughs in speed or energy efficiency.


5. Rigorous Experimental Design

Controlled Comparisons & Ablations

Nearly all papers—Whisper, FSQ, Mamba-2, BASE TTS—use systematic ablations to isolate the impact of individual components (e.g., ablation on vector-quantization vs. scalar quantization in FSQ, or size of codebooks in VQ-VAEs). This approach reveals which design decisions truly matter.

Multifold Evaluation Metrics

From MUSHRA listening tests (SoundStream, BASE TTS) to FID in image synthesis (Scaling Rectified Flow Transformers, FSQ) to perplexity or zero-shot generalization in language (phi-3, Scaling Laws for Neural Language Models), the works demonstrate the value of comprehensive, carefully chosen metrics.

Stress Tests & Edge Cases

Whisper's out-of-distribution speech benchmarks, SoundStream's evaluation on speech + music, or Mamba-2's performance on multi-query associative recall demonstrate the importance of specialized challenge sets. Researchers who craft or adopt rigorous benchmarks and "red-team" their models (as in phi-3 safety alignment) are better prepared to address real-world complexities.



Summary

Overall, an ideal researcher in deep learning consistently demonstrates:

  • A solid grounding in theoretical and statistical principles

  • A talent for proposing and validating new algorithmic solutions

  • The capacity to orchestrate data pipelines that scale and reflect real-world diversity

  • Awareness of hardware constraints and system-level trade-offs for efficiency

  • Thorough and transparent experimental practices

These qualities surface across research on speech (Whisper, BASE TTS), language modeling (Scaling Laws, phi-3), specialized hardware (TPU, Transformers are SSMs), and new representation methods (VQ-VAE, FSQ, SoundStream). By balancing these attributes—rigorous math, innovative algorithms, large-scale data engineering, hardware-savvy optimizations, and reproducible experimentation—researchers can produce impactful, trustworthy advancements in foundational deep learning.

title: Chief Information Security Officer
description: Who We Are Catalyst Capital is a profitable, bootstrapped holding company building a diversified financial services group: education, publishing, software, wealth and tax planning tools, investment products and proprietary trading technology. Funded entirely from its own operating cash. We have never taken outside capital. The cash engine is Decentralized Masters, a DeFi education business that went from zero to 150+ people, 4,500+ paying members and roughly $48.6M of FY26 revenue at ~25% earnings before tax in four years. That engine funds everything else on this page. Role summary Catalyst Capital is hiring its first Chief Information Security Officer to own security across every brand in the group. You will set the strategy, build the program, and personally run the response when something goes wrong. The job is two halves. Half is the core of a CISO's role: incident response, identity and access, vendor risk, phishing defense, policy and audit readiness, and the judgment calls only a person can own. The other half is making security AI-driven: mapping our full surface and building agentic systems that test, monitor and audit it with near-total coverage, so security keeps pace as more of the company runs on AI. This is a player-coach role: about half hands-on, leading a small team of engineers. You report to Group leadership, brief the leadership team monthly, and are the person they trust to explain risk in plain language and make the call under pressure. What you will own Core security leadership (about half) Security strategy and program. Own the security strategy, roadmap and budget across Decentralized Masters, Legacy, Inflection Club, Sentinelis and future brands. Report posture, top risks and trends to leadership every month, with a risk register leadership can act on. Incident response. Own IR end to end: detection, triage, containment, eradication, recovery and the postmortem. Lead the room during a live incident and coordinate with legal counsel, forensics firms, insurers and regulators. Keep runbooks current and run tabletop exercises. Cloud and identity security. Own identity and access across the group: SSO, MFA, least-privilege roles, admin redundancy and short-lived credentials. Set the AWS security baseline. Third-party and vendor risk. Assess the security of every vendor and data provider we depend on, including their audits and attestations, and set the bar a vendor must clear before connecting to our systems or data. raw.title: Chief Information Security Officer
raw.description:
Who We Are

Catalyst Capital is a profitable, bootstrapped holding company building a diversified financial services group: education, publishing, software, wealth and tax planning tools, investment products and proprietary trading technology. Funded entirely from its own operating cash. We have never taken outside capital.

The cash engine is Decentralized Masters, a DeFi education business that went from zero to 150+ people, 4,500+ paying members and roughly $48.6M of FY26 revenue at ~25% earnings before tax in four years. That engine funds everything else on this page.

Role summary

Catalyst Capital is hiring its first Chief Information Security Officer to own security across every brand in the group. You will set the strategy, build the program, and personally run the response when something goes wrong.

The job is two halves. Half is the core of a CISO's role: incident response, identity and access, vendor risk, phishing defense, policy and audit readiness, and the judgment calls only a person can own. The other half is making security AI-driven: mapping our full surface and building agentic systems that test, monitor and audit it with near-total coverage, so security keeps pace as more of the company runs on AI. This is a player-coach role: about half hands-on, leading a small team of engineers.

You report to Group leadership, brief the leadership team monthly, and are the person they trust to explain risk in plain language and make the call under pressure.

What you will own

Core security leadership (about half)

  • Security strategy and program. Own the security strategy, roadmap and budget across Decentralized Masters, Legacy, Inflection Club, Sentinelis and future brands. Report posture, top risks and trends to leadership every month, with a risk register leadership can act on.
  • Incident response. Own IR end to end: detection, triage, containment, eradication, recovery and the postmortem. Lead the room during a live incident and coordinate with legal counsel, forensics firms, insurers and regulators. Keep runbooks current and run tabletop exercises.
  • Cloud and identity security. Own identity and access across the group: SSO, MFA, least-privilege roles, admin redundancy and short-lived credentials. Set the AWS security baseline.
  • Third-party and vendor risk. Assess the security of every vendor and data provider we depend on, including their audits and attestations, and set the bar a vendor must clear before connecting to our systems or data.
  • Platform and customer account security. Set the standards for login protection and account-takeover defense on our platforms, and work with the engineering teams that own each platform to build them in.
  • Phishing and impersonation defense. Own email security, staff training and phishing simulations. Run brand protection: find and take down fake domains and accounts impersonating our brands and leaders.
  • Policy, compliance and trust. Write and enforce policies people actually follow. Prepare the company for SOC 2 or ISO 27001 with Legal & Compliance. Own the public security and trust story, including the trust page on our products.
  • Team leadership. Manage and develop our security engineers, decide what we build in-house versus outsource, and grow the team only where automation cannot do the job.
  • Member scam awareness. Supply the security content behind scam-awareness messaging to members, working with Community, Support and Marketing. Legal approves the wording.

AI-driven security (about half)

  • Full attack-surface map. Build and maintain a living inventory of everything we run: internal apps, cloud, code repos, and every SaaS tool and integration (CRM, telephony, community, payments, data providers). Know what connects to what, who has access, and what is logged.
  • Agentic security harness. Design and run AI-driven systems that approach 100% coverage: automated code and dependency review, continuous configuration and access audits, and vendor documentation review. Humans set direction and make the judgment calls; agents do the exhaustive work.
  • AI-driven detection and logging. Own the security stack (SIEM, Rapid7; endpoint protection; email security; identity and device management), make sure every critical system sends usable logs, and use AI to triage alerts and hunt across them.
  • Secure AI and vibe-coding standards. Set the rules for how teams build with AI: what can ship, what data AI tools may touch, and the review path before anything with customer data goes live.
  • AI agent security. As more of the company runs on agents and automations, secure them: scoped credentials and tool permissions, prompt-injection defense, data exposure, and monitoring and guardrails for agents in production. Review high-risk agents before launch, including our own security agents.

Scope

This role protects our company, our platforms, our data and our brands. For members' personal wallets and accounts outside our platforms, our role is education: helping members recognize and avoid scams.

Requirements

What you will bring

Must have

  • 10+ years in security, including 3+ years leading a security function as CISO, Head of Security or equivalent at a company of 100+ people.
  • Has led live-incident response, not just tabletop exercises, including briefing executives during the incident.
  • Has built or rebuilt a security program from an early stage: strategy, policy, tooling, training and incident response.
  • AI-native operator. Uses AI agents daily to do the work: writing detections, reviewing code and configs, reading vendor documentation, drafting policy. Can show us the harnesses, workflows or automations you have built, and knows where AI stops and human judgment has to take over.
  • Deep, current knowledge of AI-specific risks: prompt injection, over-scoped agent permissions, credential and data exposure through AI tools, and insecure AI-generated code.
  • Hands-on with cloud security (AWS preferred), identity and access management, SIEM, endpoint protection and email security.
  • Writes code: scripts, tooling and automation, not only vendor UIs.
  • Experience in crypto, fintech or another high-fraud industry, and deep knowledge of phishing, social engineering and impersonation attacks.
  • Can read the fine print: thorough with documentation, contracts and vendor security terms, and documents everything so nothing slips through.
  • Briefs executives in plain language, trains non-technical staff, and writes policy people follow.
  • Player-coach: comfortable spending about half your time hands-on while leading a small, fully remote team across many time zones.

Nice to have

  • Has prepared a company for SOC 2 or ISO 27001.
  • Has secured or evaluated AI agents and LLM-based tools in production.
  • Has run a third-party risk program covering financial data aggregators or similar providers.
  • Has run a brand protection or takedown program.
  • Experience with customer-facing security features such as account-takeover defense.
  • Experience with risk quantification (FAIR or similar) and presenting to a board.
  • Certifications such as CISSP, CISM, GCIH or OSCP.

Benefits

What We Offer

  • Competitive compensation package
  • Independent Contractor opportunity
  • Fully remote, globally distributed team
  • Team offsites (Dubai, Costa Rica, etc.)
  • Collaborative, forward-thinking culture that values innovation and results

Bij ons speel je een sleutelrol in de verdere ontwikkeling van onze Software Engineering-organisatie. Je bent verantwoordelijk voor de groei, kwaliteit en prestaties van een team van circa 45 (embedded) softwareprofessionals en zorgt ervoor dat zij de juiste omgeving, richting en ondersteuning krijgen om complexe technologische uitdagingen succesvol aan te gaan.

 

Je beweegt je op het snijvlak van technologie, leiderschap en organisatieontwikkeling. Daarbij richt jij je niet alleen op de resultaten van vandaag, maar bouw je ook aan de softwareorganisatie van morgen. Je creëert een omgeving waarin vakmanschap, kennisdeling, innovatie en continue verbetering centraal staan. Daarnaast volg je technologische ontwikkelingen op de voet en stimuleer je de inzet van moderne technologieën om softwareontwikkeling slimmer, sneller en effectiever te maken.

 

Jouw verantwoordelijkheden

  • Je geeft leiding aan een team van ongeveer 45 embedded software engineers en ondersteunt hen in hun professionele en persoonlijke groei.

  • Je geeft richting aan AI-gedreven transformatie binnen het softwareteam én de bredere organisatie, en neemt je team en collega’s mee in nieuwe manieren van werken.

  • Je stimuleert een cultuur van technische excellentie, eigenaarschap en samenwerking.

  • Je zorgt voor de juiste balans tussen projectresultaten, de ontwikkeling van je team en langetermijndoelstellingen.

  • Je werkt samen met architecten, technical leads en projectteams aan de verdere professionalisering van softwareontwikkeling binnen Benchmark.

  • Je bewaakt de benodigde capaciteit, competenties en inzetbaarheid van de afdeling.

  • Je speelt een actieve rol in het aantrekken, ontwikkelen en behouden van softwaretalent.

  • Je versterkt de samenwerking met internationale engineeringteams binnen Benchmark.

  • Je vertegenwoordigt Software Engineering binnen het Competence Management Team en levert een actieve bijdrage aan organisatiebrede besluitvorming.

  • Je stimuleert het gebruik van moderne ontwikkelmethodieken en tooling om kwaliteit, productiviteit en innovatie te versterken.

  • Je vertaalt technologische ontwikkelingen naar concrete verbeteringen in processen, werkwijzen en engineering excellence.

 

Samen met de managers van Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering en Test Development Engineering werk je aan een toekomstbestendige engineeringorganisatie. Daarbij zoek je continu naar manieren om samenwerking tussen disciplines te versterken en technologische ontwikkelingen succesvol naar de praktijk te vertalen.

 

Waarom deze functie?

Deze rol biedt een unieke combinatie van people leadership, technologie en strategische impact. Je krijgt de ruimte om onze softwareorganisatie verder vorm te geven, talent te ontwikkelen en invloed uit te oefenen op de manier waarop complexe high-tech producten worden ontworpen en ontwikkeld. Tegelijkertijd krijg je de mogelijkheid om de toepassing van nieuwe technologieën, waaronder AI, binnen de organisatie verder te verkennen en te helpen verankeren.

 

Wat biedt Benchmark?

Bij Benchmark werk je aan producten die ertoe doen! Daarnaast zijn wij bij uitstek een organisatie waar je vrijheid krijgt, waar ondernemerschap wordt beloond en waarin je de ruimte krijgt om je ideeën tot uitvoering te brengen. We bieden je een dynamische omgeving met de ruimte om snel stappen te maken, door te groeien en verantwoordelijkheid te nemen. Je bent onderdeel van een wereldwijd bedrijf waar de nuchtere Twentse cultuur bewaard is gebleven.

 

Bij ons krijg je uitdagend werk, veel vertrouwen en ruimte om jezelf te blijven

ontwikkelen. Je werkt met nuchtere collega’s in een informele cultuur, met goede

voorwaarden om duurzaam te presteren.

 

Daarnaast bieden wij:

  • Een aantrekkelijk salaris

  • Een bonusregeling gekoppeld aan de prestaties van jouw team en de organisatie.

  • Een managementcontract met veel ruimte voor ondernemerschap, eigen verantwoordelijkheid en impact op de verdere ontwikkeling van de organisatie.

  • Persoonlijke groei en ontwikkeling, waarbij we samen een ontwikkelpad creëren dat aansluit op jouw ambities en de behoeften van de organisatie.

  • Flexibiliteit in de inrichting van je werkweek, met ruimte om werk en privé op een manier te combineren die voor jou werkt.

  • Een sterk kennisgedreven engineeringklimaat, waarin samenwerking, kennisdeling en innovatie centraal staan. Via initiatieven zoals Lunch & Learn-sessies en Pitch Discovery Sessions krijg je volop ruimte om te leren, te inspireren en nieuwe ideeën te ontwikkelen.

 

Wie ben jij?

Of je nu een ervaren engineering manager bent of toe bent aan je eerste grotere leiderschapsrol, jij krijgt energie van technologie én het ontwikkelen van mensen. Je weet professionals te verbinden, richting te geven en samen resultaten te behalen in een complexe high-tech omgeving. Met jouw technische achtergrond, nieuwsgierigheid en leiderschapspotentieel bouw je mee aan de volgende generatie engineers én innovaties. Herken jij jezelf hierin? Dan maken we graag kennis met je.

 

  • Een afgeronde hbo- of wo-opleiding in embedded software, elektrotechniek, natuurkunde  of een vergelijkbare technische richting.

  • Je hebt een stevige achtergrond in embedded systems en voldoende technische diepgang om met engineers en architecten te sparren over technische keuzes en ontwikkelrichtingen.

  • Minimaal zeven jaar ervaring binnen een hightech-ontwikkelomgeving, inclusief enkele jaren in een leidinggevende rol of een technische leiderschapsrol.

  • Aantoonbare ervaring met het aansturen, coachen en ontwikkelen van engineeringteams binnen een complexe technische organisatie.

  • Het vermogen om technische visie, organisatiedoelstellingen en talentontwikkeling succesvol met elkaar te verbinden.

  • Uitstekende communicatieve vaardigheden en een goede beheersing van zowel de Nederlandse als Engelse taal.

 

Serious Tech
Bij Benchmark werk je voor bedrijven die impact maken met hun innovaties. Zo ontwikkelen we nieuwe producten die de veiligheid of gezondheid verbeteren of juist het gemak vergroten. Deze producten worden geleverd vanaf het productontwerp tot en met volumeproductie en soms ook rechtstreeks aan de eindgebruiker. Dit gehele proces wordt geheel in Almelo uitgevoerd, waar we samenwerken met ongeveer 650 collega’s

 

We werken aan innovaties voor, onder andere, semicon, gezondheidszorg, aerospace en industrie. Van productontwerp tot volumeproductie: het hele proces komt hier samen. Technisch ligt de lat hoog, maar de cultuur blijft nuchter en dichtbij. Je werkt met mensen die verantwoordelijkheid nemen, elkaar helpen en samen willen blijven verbeteren.

 

Seriously you?

We zoeken mensen die energie krijgen van complexe technologie en niet terugdeinzen voor een stevige uitdaging. Mensen die verantwoordelijkheid pakken, ideeën delen en samen willen blijven verbeteren. Herken jij jezelf daarin? Dan praten we graag verder.

title: Senior Account Executive - Benelux
description: Help fix customer-centricity at scale Every company wants to become more customer-centric. At TheyDo, we make that ambition real. Our AI-powered journey management platform helps the world’s largest enterprises align around what matters most: their customers. By bringing scattered data and teams together, we empower smarter decisions and better experiences. Since 2019, global leaders across industries — including Ford, Cisco, Johnson & Johnson, Siemens, Home Depot, and Lufthansa — have trusted us to scale journey management and deliver measurable impact. Backed by $50M from top-tier investors, including Blossom and 20VC, we are building a category-defining company. Our fully remote team of 100+ TheyDoers represents 30+ nationalities across 27 countries, united by a customer-led, people-first culture. Our mission is clear: Make journey management the most powerful business tool in the world. If you’re looking for a place where your work shapes the future of how companies operate, join us. Let’s build it together. The role Journey management is becoming a must-have for the world's biggest companies, and TheyDo is the platform leading the category. Enterprises like Ford, Cisco, Vodafone and Pfizer already use TheyDo to understand their customers end to end and decide where to act. Now we're going after the rest of Europes biggest brands, and we want you leading the charge. As a Senior Account Executive, you'll take a greenfield territory of enterprise accounts, open the doors, and land the new logos that define TheyDo's next chapter. You'll be based in the Benelux, working remotely and reporting to Stephan . You'll join a team of 6 EU AEs, backed by SDR, Enablement and Customer Success colleagues across North America and Europe. Why this role, now The timing couldn't be better. Customer experience has moved into the boardroom, and enterprises want a way to turn it into decisions. TheyDo gives them that, and our customers are proving it. Europe is wide open. Your target list is full of companies that look just like the ones already buying from us, and most of them have never had a TheyDo conversation. We know what wins. raw.title: Senior Account Executive - Benelux
raw.description:
Help fix customer-centricity at scale


Every company wants to become more customer-centric. At TheyDo, we make that ambition real. Our AI-powered journey management platform helps the world’s largest enterprises align around what matters most: their customers. By bringing scattered data and teams together, we empower smarter decisions and better experiences. Since 2019, global leaders across industries — including Ford, Cisco, Johnson & Johnson, Siemens, Home Depot, and Lufthansa — have trusted us to scale journey management and deliver measurable impact.

Backed by $50M from top-tier investors, including Blossom and 20VC, we are building a category-defining company. Our fully remote team of 100+ TheyDoers represents 30+ nationalities across 27 countries, united by a customer-led, people-first culture.

Our mission is clear: Make journey management the most powerful business tool in the world.

If you’re looking for a place where your work shapes the future of how companies operate, join us. Let’s build it together.

The role

Journey management is becoming a must-have for the world's biggest companies, and TheyDo is the platform leading the category. Enterprises like Ford, Cisco, Vodafone and Pfizer already use TheyDo to understand their customers end to end and decide where to act.

Now we're going after the rest of Europes biggest brands, and we want you leading the charge. As a Senior Account Executive, you'll take a greenfield territory of enterprise accounts, open the doors, and land the new logos that define TheyDo's next chapter.

You'll be based in the Benelux, working remotely and reporting to Stephan. You'll join a team of 6 EU AEs, backed by SDR, Enablement and Customer Success colleagues across North America and Europe.

Why this role, now

The timing couldn't be better. Customer experience has moved into the boardroom, and enterprises want a way to turn it into decisions. TheyDo gives them that, and our customers are proving it.

Europe is wide open. Your target list is full of companies that look just like the ones already buying from us, and most of them have never had a TheyDo conversation. We know what wins. Now we need someone to scale it and put their name on the logos that come next.

This is the moment to join: early enough to shape how we win, with the proof that we do.

What you'll do

This is a role built around creating revenue that didn't exist before, not managing revenue that already does.

Build your own pipeline. You'll start from a target list, not a book.

  • Own a named list of Benelux enterprise accounts and decide where to focus, based on signal rather than hope

  • Source most of your pipeline yourself through outbound, account-based plays with BDR and Marketing, events and executive networking

  • Break into accounts with no existing relationship and find the senior person who owns the customer experience problem


Win the first deal. You'll take a cold account all the way to signature.

  • Run complex, multi-stakeholder cycles from first conversation through discovery, business case, procurement and close

  • Sell on value to C-level and VP buyers across CX, Product and Digital: a business case a CFO will sign, not a feature tour

  • Land mid-to-high six-figure first deals, structured to expand, and hand them to Customer Success with the context to grow them

Shape how we win. You'll help write the European playbook.

  • Refine our ICP, messaging and sales motion based on what you see in the field

  • Share buyer insight with Product so they can act on it

  • Forecast accurately and keep the team informed through clear async updates

What this role isn't

We'd rather be clear now than have the wrong person find out six months in.

  • It isn't account management. You won't inherit renewals or an installed base to upsell. If most of your number has come from growing existing customers, this probably isn't your role.

  • It isn't inbound-led. Marketing and SDR will support you, but you'll be expected to create most of your own pipeline.

  • It isn't a finished machine. If you need fully built enablement, years of territory data and a playbook that tells you what to do next, you'll find this frustrating. If you want to help build those things, you'll find it energizing.

What we're looking for

  • 4+ years closing B2B SaaS deals, with most of that in enterprise new-business roles selling into enterprise organizations.

  • A track record of exceeding annual quotas, where the majority of your closed revenue came from net-new logos you sourced yourself. Be ready to walk us through the numbers.

  • Proven ability to land mid-to-high six-figure first deals with enterprises that weren't customers before.

  • Experience selling a platform or new-category product, where you had to create the need rather than respond to an RFP.

  • A value-selling methodology (MEDDPICC, Command of the Message or similar) you actually use, not just know.

  • Confidence engaging C-level buyers, building consensus across stakeholders and navigating enterprise procurement, security and legal

  • You'd rather start with a blank target list than a handed-over book, and you're energized by a scale-up where the product and playbook move fast

Bonus points if you have experience selling to CX, Product, Digital or Design leaders

What we offer our permanent employees:

💰 Competitive compensation and pre-IPO equity - we like to give our team members ownership with our stock package. When TheyDo succeeds, we all succeed!

🌍 Fully remote working with flexible hours - we're staunch advocates for autonomy and flexibility.

🩺 Health Insurance benefit - at TheyDo our team’s health and wellbeing are a priority. We include tailored support for every employee, regardless of location.

🌴 Flexible holiday days – We love what we do and equally love taking a break. You'll have a minimum of 25 days of paid holiday per year (pro rata), in addition to public holidays and an extra three days during our annual company-wide winter shutdown in December.

🧠 Learning and Development budget we encourage everyone to take ownership and invest in their growth and development, providing financial support to benefit you in your role and career.

🧘‍♂️Wellbeing budget - nurture your mind and body. We’ll support you in looking after you, whether it's meditation, mindfulness, or a yoga/gym membership.

👪 Paid parental leave - we'll ensure financial support and time off for you to bond with the newest little members of your family (6 months for the primary carer, and 6 weeks for the secondary carer - fully paid). We provide paid childcare leave when you need to take time out to help your little one recover.

👨‍💻Home office or co-working support - choose your ideal workspace with our home office or co-working budget. Whether you prefer the comfort of your home office or the collaborative atmosphere of a co-working space, we've got you covered.

🗺️ Company events - we regularly connect in-person to strategise, reflect or simply have fun. Our most recent company retreats were held in Spain, Portugal and France.

⚒️ Latest tech & tools - MacBook Air or Pro, we want you to have the equipment that you’re most comfortable with. We use tools such as Gather, Slack, Notion, Loom, G:Suite and naturally TheyDo to work collaboratively and asynchronously.

🚀 Continuous growth of our benefits package as we continue to grow in size

To any recruitment agencies, we appreciate you would like to support us but we do not accept any unsolicited CVs or introductions.

About TheyDo

Our core values are the driving force behind every decision we make.

We ‘Journey together’ along a path of collaboration and synchronization. In everything we do, we ‘Own it’, never shying away from taking action or making decisions. Our ‘Cloaks off’ mentality ensures that transparency and integrity reign supreme. We ‘Simply to accelerate', cutting through complexity to focus on what truly matters and moving forward with clarity and speed Moreover, ‘Customer Fueled’ innovation is at the heart of our work, as we know that the success of our product is directly linked to how we involve our customers in the process.

TheyDo is an equal opportunities employer. Our customers are diverse, and we believe our organisation should be, too. We nurture an inclusive culture where everyone feels equally important, no matter their background or status. We will never discriminate on the grounds of gender, civil status, family status, sexual orientation, religion, age, disability, education, or race.

Our commitment to building a diverse and inclusive TheyDo includes making reasonable adjustments to the interview process. If you need any adjustments, please reach out to your Talent Partner.

If you are a woman or part of an underrepresented group, we encourage you to apply. Even if you don’t check every box — your skills and perspective could be just what we need to succeed. We value diversity and know you bring something unique to the table!

raw.title: Process Safety Lead
raw.description:
About the role

As SkyNRG grows, we are looking for a Process Safety Lead to build and embed our corporate Process Safety Management framework.

In this role, you will set the standards for how process safety is managed across our projects and future assets, from design and construction through commissioning and operations. Working across Engineering, Projects, Operations and HSE, you will combine technical expertise with functional leadership to strengthen process safety across the organization.

Your key responsibilities include:

  • Develop and implement SkyNRG’s corporate Process Safety Management (PSM) framework as part of the Integrated Management System.

  • Establish and embed process safety standards and procedures across current and future projects, including construction, commissioning, start-up and operations.

  • Ensure compliance with SEVESO III requirements and support the Major Accident Prevention Policy, Safety Reports, regulatory inspections and audits.

  • Govern key process safety activities, including HAZOP, LOPA, QRA and Management of Change (MOC).

  • Develop and monitor process safety KPIs and barrier management to strengthen risk control and performance.

  • Lead process safety audits, incident learning and improvement initiatives across projects and assets.

  • Build process safety capability across the organization through training, guidance and functional leadership for Engineering, Projects, Operations, Maintenance and contractors.

Your profile

As a growing company in a rapidly evolving industry, we are looking for people who embrace change and are motivated to actively contribute to building and scaling our business. You are someone who feels comfortable in an entrepreneurial environment, takes ownership, and thrives when things are still developing.

You combine deep technical expertise with the ability to turn complex regulatory and risk-management requirements into practical standards. Structured and strategic in your approach, you are also willing to work hands-on to move implementation forward. You communicate clearly, make risk-based decisions, and can influence senior stakeholders without relying on formal authority.

You recognize yourself in the following:

  • A master’s degree in Chemical Engineering, Process Engineering, Process Safety, or a closely related technical discipline.

  • At least five years of relevant process safety experience within oil and gas, renewable fuels, chemicals, or another major hazard environment.

  • Practical knowledge of SEVESO III requirements and their application within Major Accident Hazard facilities.

  • Demonstrated experience developing or implementing Process Safety Management frameworks, Integrated Management Systems, or corporate process safety standards.

  • Strong technical expertise in HAZOP, LOPA, QRA, Management of Change, Mechanical Integrity, contractor management, and commissioning or start-up activities.

  • Experience assessing, governing, or assuring hazard studies across projects or operational environments.

  • A proven ability to design and deliver process safety training for multidisciplinary audiences.

  • Strong incident investigation skills, with the ability to translate findings into organizational learning and sustainable improvements.

  • The ability to influence stakeholders across Engineering, Projects, Operations, Maintenance, and site leadership.

  • Professional fluency in English.

  • Experience with digital risk-assessment or barrier-management tools would be an advantage. A recognized qualification such as MoSHE, NEBOSH Process Safety, or an equivalent certification is also beneficial. Direct experience engaging with regulators or contributing to SEVESO Safety Reports would make your profile particularly relevant.

About SkyNRG

Since 2009, SkyNRG has been a change maker in the aviation industry. We are dedicated to supplying and producing high-integrity Sustainable Aviation Fuel (SAF), making sustainable aviation a reality.

Collaboration is fundamental to achieving our ambition. We nurture genuine relationships with global partners in our drive to make SAF the alternative to fossil jet fuel.

Our in-house team of SAF experts have helped over 60 airlines and corporates reduce their climate impact using the Book & Claim mechanism; the most transparent and traceable way to support aviation sustainability with real emission reductions.

Sustainability is woven into the fabric of our company. We maintain an independent Sustainability Board, which advises the company on feedstocks and provides strategic guidance on wide-ranging sustainability issues. SkyNRG operations are certified against the RSB EU RED, CORSIA, and Book & Claim standards.

At SkyNRG, you’ll find:

  • An innovation-driven culture – where big ideas turn into real impact

  • Growth opportunities – in a fast-scaling, industry-changing company

  • A collaborative team – where your ideas and expertise are valued

  • A mission that matters – leading the change in the energy transition by producing and supplying high-integrity SAF

What we offer

We offer a brand-new office in the heart of Amsterdam, designed for collaboration and creativity. Most importantly, you’ll have the opportunity to contribute to a truly game-changing green initiative, making a real impact on the aviation industry and the planet.

Besides that, we offer:

  • 30 paid holidays + 2 for choosing sustainable travel options for your holidays

  • Contribute to a sustainable organization (B Corp)

  • Attractive bonus scheme

  • €5.000,- dedicated budget every 3 years for professional development

  • Commuting travel reimbursement + Lease a Bike plan

  • An office in the city centre of Amsterdam (Nieuwmarkt)

  • Work where it feels best for you: we offer flexible (hybrid in-office) working arrangements

  • Generous employer pension contribution

  • Paid Volunteering Day

  • Access to our electric company boat (also available for private use), free lunch, and lots of social activities – all part of the deal!

Is this you?

Are you ready to take the next step in your career with SkyNRG? Explore our vacancies and become part of our company of change makers. Together, we can change the future of flying.

title: Accounts Payable Specialist
description: At i3D.net , we provide world-class global coverage with one of the most interconnected networks in the world. Our solutions focus on low latency, zero packet loss, and unmatched scalability, enabling seamless experiences for millions of users worldwide. With dedicated support, bespoke solutions, and cutting-edge technology, we deliver reliable, cost-efficient infrastructure that empowers game developers and businesses to scale effortlessly. Partnering with major names like Nvidia, DuckDuckGo , and Ubisoft , we are shaping the future of gaming and network technology. Bij i3D.net bouwen we aan de toekomst van gaming en netwerktechnologie. Met een van de meest verbonden netwerken ter wereld bieden we internationale infrastructuuroplossingen voor miljoenen gebruikers. We combineren minimale vertraging, betrouwbare verbindingen en schaalbaarheid met persoonlijke ondersteuning en maatwerk. Zo helpen we gameontwikkelaars en bedrijven zoals NVIDIA, DuckDuckGo en Ubisoft om wereldwijd te groeien. Ons Finance-team zorgt ervoor dat onze groeiende internationale organisatie ook financieel op rolletjes loopt. Daarom zoeken we een nauwkeurige, betrokken en proactieve Financieel Administratief Medewerker met een focus op Accounts Payable. Jouw rol Samen met je collega’s verzorg je de dagelijkse financiële administratie, met jouw focus op het crediteurenproces. Je zorgt dat inkoopfacturen correct worden verwerkt, tijdig worden goedgekeurd en volgens afspraak worden betaald. Je bent een zichtbaar en toegankelijk aanspreekpunt binnen de organisatie. Je zoekt actief contact met collega’s, bewaakt de voortgang van factuurgoedkeuringen en volgt openstaande acties proactief op. Bij afwijkingen zoek je uit wat er speelt en werk je samen met leveranciers en collega’s aan een oplossing. Daarnaast onderhoud je de workflows en autorisatieschema’s in 4cee, het factuurverwerkingssysteem. Daarmee help je het factuurverwerkingsproces efficiënt en overzichtelijk te houden. Je maakt deel uit van een Finance-team van acht collega’s en rapporteert aan de Finance Manager. Wat je gaat doen Controleren en boeken van inkoopfacturen op de juiste grootboekrekening en kostenplaats, met toepassing van de juiste btw-code. Controleren of facturen aansluiten op contractuele afspraken en, waar van toepassing, inkooporders. Bewaken van de voortgang van factuurgoedkeuringen en proactief opvolgen van openstaande acties bij collega’s. Uitzoeken en oplossen van afwijkende, geblokkeerde of onvolledige facturen. Onderhouden van workflows en autorisatieschema’s in 4cee, in afstemming met de verantwoordelijke collega’s. Voorbereiden van betaalvoorstellen en verwerken van betalingen volgens de interne autorisatieprocedure. Verwerken van bankmutaties die betrekking hebben op leveranciersbetalingen. Bijhouden en controleren van leveranciersgegevens volgens de afgesproken procedures. Onderhouden van leverancierscontact over facturen, betalingen en openstaande vragen. Controleren en afstemmen van openstaande crediteurenposten. Ondersteunen bij de maand- en jaarafsluiting, onder meer door ontbrekende facturen en nog te verwerken kosten te signaleren. Zorgen voor een volledige en controleerbare digitale administratie. Signaleren van knelpunten en meedenken over verbeteringen in de financiële processen en systemen. Hoe succes in het eerste jaar eruitziet Je kent onze financiële processen en systemen en voert je dagelijkse werkzaamheden zelfstandig uit. Facturen worden correct verwerkt en tijdig ter goedkeuring en betaling aangeboden. Je houdt overzicht over openstaande posten en acties en schakelt tijdig wanneer de voortgang dreigt vast te lopen. Collega’s weten je te vinden en jij weet wie je moet benaderen om zaken verder te brengen. De workflows en autorisatieschema’s in 4cee zijn actueel en je hebt bijgedragen aan een efficiënter factuurverwerkingsproces. Tijdens de maand- en jaarafsluiting lever je de benodigde informatie tijdig en zorgvuldig aan. Wie jij bent Je werkt nauwkeurig en gestructureerd en neemt verantwoordelijkheid voor je werk. Je stelt prioriteiten, houdt overzicht en wacht niet af wanneer iets blijft liggen. Je zoekt actief de samenwerking op en spreekt collega’s op een prettige, duidelijke manier aan op openstaande acties. Je bent nieuwsgierig, leert graag en denkt mee over hoe processen beter kunnen. Een internationale technische omgeving spreekt je aan en je vindt het leuk om vanuit Finance bij te dragen aan een organisatie in de wereld van gaming, infrastructuur en hosting. Je hebt een afgeronde mbo-opleiding in een financiële richting en minimaal 3 jaar ervaring in een vergelijkbare financiële administratieve functie, bij voorkeur binnen de crediteurenadministratie. Ervaring met verschillende btw-codes en het correct toepassen daarvan bij de verwerking van inkoopfacturen. Praktische kennis van Excel en affiniteit met financiële systemen en digitale factuurverwerking. Goede communicatieve vaardigheden in het Nederlands en Engels voor contact met collega’s en internationale leveranciers. Beschikbaarheid van minimaal 24 uur per week, met ten minste twee vaste dagen op kantoor in Rotterdam. Ervaring met NetSuite en 4cee is een pré. Waarom werken bij i3D.net ? Maak het verschil: Draag bij aan een solide financiële basis voor een internationaal bedrijf met een jarenlange staat van dienst. Hybride werken Profiteer van flexibel hybride werken, een thuiswerkbudget en hoogwaardige hulpmiddelen. Ruimte om te groeien Ontwikkel je verder met een vergoeding voor opleidingen, loopbaanbegeleiding en mogelijkheden om je kennis en vaardigheden uit te breiden. Aantrekkelijke arbeidsvoorwaarden Een marktconform salaris, een jaarlijkse bonus, 25 vakantiedagen naast de officiële feestdagen, een reiskostenvergoeding en een premievrije pensioenregeling. title: Forward Deployed Engineer | Finance
description: Jij zorgt dat AI niet bij een financiële pilot blijft, maar helpt in het echte werk. Een slimme AI-demo maakt indruk. Maar pas als analisten en medewerkers er elke dag mee werken, wordt technologie waardevol. Zeker in finance, waar betrouwbaarheid, controleerbaarheid en regelgeving nooit bijzaak zijn. Als Senior Forward Deployed AI Engineer ben je erbij vanaf het eerste gesprek. Je brengt "we willen iets met AI" binnen weken terug tot een use case die je kunt testen, of je zegt eerlijk dat het (nog) niet kan. Daarna ontwerp en bouw je de oplossing en breng je hem live in cycli van dagen. En dan maak je jezelf overbodig. Wat ga je doen? Je slaat de brug tussen business en techniek: je zit aan tafel bij de klant, ontwerpt de oplossing en implementeert vaak ook zelf. Use cases scherp krijgen: samen met business development voer je discoverygesprekken, toets je use cases aan echte data en systemen en bouw je in dagen een proof-of-value. Ontwerpen en uitvoeren: je ontwerpt de agentic architectuur, kiest per situatie het patroon dat past en brengt de oplossing in korte cycli naar productie, samen met onze AI Engineers. Overdragen en meten: de klant kan de oplossing zelf draaien, en na go-live meet je of hij echt gebruikt wordt. Dát is je maatstaf. Ons slimmer maken: wat je leert, maak je herbruikbaar voor de volgende klant, en je helpt nieuwe FDE's op weg. Ongeveer 10% van je tijd gaat naar pre-sales en 90% naar delivery; business development is commercieel eigenaar. Van KYC tot complexe financiële processen Je kent de werkelijkheid achter KYC/AML, klantacceptatie, klachten- en schadeafhandeling, financiële rapportage, risk en compliance. Denk aan: KYC-dossiers die agents voorbereiden met herleidbare bronnen, zodat analisten sneller onderbouwd beslissen. Documenten en signalen die samenkomen voor een klachten- of schadeteam. Rapportages die nu handwerk zijn, geautomatiseerd binnen de kaders van DORA en de EU AI Act. Wat breng je mee? Aantoonbare ervaring in finance: je kent de processen, data, systemen en risico's van binnenuit. Je hebt AI-oplossingen met LLM's en agents ontworpen, in productie gebracht én onderhouden, inclusief evals, guardrails, monitoring en security. Sterk in Python en SQL, en hands-on met minimaal één cloud (Azure, AWS of GCP) en een dataplatform zoals Databricks, Snowflake of Fabric. Je werkt dagelijks met coding agents en beoordeelt kritisch wat ze opleveren. Ervaring in een klantgerichte rol, zoals consultancy, pre-sales, solutions engineering of je eigen startup. Je spreekt en schrijft vloeiend Nederlands en Engels. Mooi meegenomen: ervaring met DORA, model risk management of audit trails, en met klassieke ML zoals fraude- en risicomodellen. Wat dit níet is Geen individuele detachering. Je werkt aan projecten namens adesso, met een team achter je. Geen PoC-kerkhof. We bouwen om te gebruiken. Geen slides zonder code. Je advies komt met een werkende versie. Geen agent omdat het kan. Soms is de simpelste oplossing de beste, en dat zeg je dan. Het team Je wordt onderdeel van ons AI Engineering-team: AI engineering consultants in twee rollen. De Forward Deployed AI Engineer (FDE) is eigenaar van het klantprobleem en ontwerpt de oplossing, inclusief de agentic architectuur. De AI Engineer gaat de diepte in op bouw, data, MLOps en schaal, en denkt vanaf de klantvraag mee over de juiste aanpak. Je krijgt ruimte om je eigen werk vorm te geven, maar je bent nooit alleen verantwoordelijk voor alle specialismen. Twijfel je welke rol het best bij je past? Solliciteer dan gewoon; we kijken samen.  Waarom adesso? Omdat je bij ons écht kunt meebouwen. Bij adesso Nederland draait het om meer dan alleen technologie. We bouwen slimme oplossingen die daadwerkelijk waarde toevoegen voor onze klanten. Geen eindeloze experimenten of AI omdat het hip is, maar technologie die werkt en impact maakt. We zijn onderdeel van de internationale adesso Group, met ruim 11.500 collega's op meer dan 60 locaties. Tegelijkertijd zijn we in Nederland een relatief klein en persoonlijk team, met korte lijnen, veel vrijheid en ruimte voor eigen initiatief. Groot genoeg om impact te maken, klein genoeg om het verschil te voelen. AI-native: wij omarmen AI, ook in ons eigen werk We geloven dat AI fundamenteel verandert hoe we software bouwen, met data werken en klanten helpen. Daarom bouwen we niet aan losse experimenten, maar aan dataplatformen, AI-first applicaties en agentic oplossingen die echt onderdeel worden van bedrijfsprocessen. Dat geldt ook voor hoe we zelf werken. Met onze Agentic Delivery-aanpak en eigen tools kun je echt vliegen: Context en kennisbank: agents werken met wat er écht speelt bij de klant, en kennis en beslissingen blijven herleidbaar voor mens én agent. AgentOps en governance: zicht op wat agents doen en controle over wat ze mogen, zodat ze veilig en binnen de regels werken. adSCAILE: ons eigen framework waarmee je samen met AI-agents bouwt, geïntegreerd, veilig en traceerbaar, in cycli van twee tot vier dagen in plaats van sprints van weken. Je gebruikt deze tools dagelijks en helpt ze verder te ontwikkelen. adesso is bovendien Select Partner in het Claude Partner Network van Anthropic. En we blijven kritisch: niet alles hoeft met AI. De beste oplossing staat altijd voorop. En misschien wel het belangrijkste: de mensen Je komt terecht in een team waar vakmanschap, ondernemerschap en kennisdeling centraal staan. Je werkt met ervaren specialisten en groeit door in technische visie en in verantwoordelijkheid voor klantrelaties. We houden van collega's die nieuwsgierig zijn, kennis delen en elkaar verder helpen. Mensen die goed zijn in hun vak, maar ook plezier hebben in samenwerken.
